metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: on Twitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah, that's interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah, we do have an incredible ability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Like, I mean, how many memes are created in a given day and the ones that go viral are

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: almost uniformly funny, at least to somebody with a particular sense of humor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah, and I have to think about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We are definitely great at creating atomized units of funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Like in the example that you used, there are going to be X million brains parsing and judging

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: whether this meme is retweetable or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so that sort of atomic element of funniness, of entertaininess, et cetera, we definitely

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: have an environment that's good at selecting for that and selective pressure and everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: else that's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But in terms of the entire ecosystem of conscious systems here on the earth, driving for a level

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of entertainment, that is on such a much higher level that I don't know if that would necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: follow directly from the fact that atomic units of entertainment are very, very aptly

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: selected for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Do you find it compelling or useful to think about human civilization from the perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of the ideas versus the perspective of the individual human brains?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So almost thinking about the ideas or the memes, this is the Dawkins thing as the organisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and then the humans as just like vehicles for briefly carrying those organisms as they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: jump around and spread.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah, for propagating them, mutating them, putting selective pressure on them, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I found Dawkins' launching of the idea of memes is just kind of an afterthought to his

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: unbelievably brilliant book about the selfish gene.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What a PS to put at the end of a long chunk of writing, profoundly interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I view the relationship though between humans and memes as probably an oversimplification,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: but maybe a little bit like the relationship between flowers and bees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Do flowers have bees or do bees in a sense have flowers?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the answer is it is a very, very symbiotic relationship in which both have semi-independent

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: roles that they play and both are highly dependent upon the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so in the case of bees, obviously, you could see the flowers being this monolithic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: structure physically in relation to any given bee and it's the source of food and sustenance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So you could kind of say, well, flowers have bees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But on the other hand, the flowers would obviously be doomed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They weren't being pollinated by the bees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So you could kind of say, well, bees, flowers are really expression of what the bees need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the truth is a symbiosis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So with memes and human minds, our brains are clearly the petri dishes in which memes

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: are either propagated or not propagated, get mutated or don't get mutated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They are the venue in which competition, selective competition plays out between different memes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So all of that is very true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And you could look at that and say, really, the human mind is a production of memes and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: ideas have us rather than us having ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But at the same time, let's take a catchy tune as an example of a meme.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That catchy tune did originate in a human mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Somebody had to structure that thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And as much as I like Elizabeth Gilbert's TED talk about how the universe, I'm simplifying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that the ideas find their way in this beautiful TED talk, it's very lyrical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: She talked about ideas and prose kind of beaming into our minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And she talked about needing to pull over the side of the road when she got inspiration

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: for a particular paragraph or a particular idea and a burning need to write that down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I love that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I find that beautiful as a writer, as a novelist myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I've never had that experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think that really most things that do become memes are the product of a great deal

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of deliberate and willful exertion of a conscious mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so like the bees and the flowers, I think there's a great symbiosis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And they both kind of have one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Ideas have us, but we have ideas for real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If we could take a little bit of a tangent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Stephen King on writing, you as a great writer, you're dropping a hint here that the ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: don't come to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's a grind of sort of it's almost like you're mining for gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's more of a very deliberate, rigorous daily process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So maybe can you talk about the writing process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: How do you write well?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And maybe if you want to step outside of yourself, almost like give advice to an aspiring writer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: what does it take to write the best work of your life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, it would be very different if it's fiction versus nonfiction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I've done both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I've written two nonfiction books and two works of fiction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Two works of fiction being more recent, I'm going to focus on that right now because that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: more toweringly on my mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Amongst novelists, again, this is an oversimplification, but there's kind of two schools of thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Some people really like to fly by the seat of their pants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And some people really, really like to outline, to plot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So there's plotters and pantsers, I guess is one way that people look at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And as with most things, there is a great continuum in between.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I'm somewhere on that continuum, but I lean, I guess, a little bit more toward the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: plotter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so when I do start a novel, I have a pretty strong point of view about how it's going

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I have a very strong point of view about how it's going to begin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I do try to make an effort of making an outline that I know I'm going to be extremely

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: unfaithful to in the actual execution of the story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I'm trying to make an outline that gets us from here to there and notion of subplots

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and beats and rhythm and different characters and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But then when I get into the process, that outline, particularly the center of it, ultimately

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: inevitably morphs a great deal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think if I were personally a rigorous outliner, I would not allow that to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I also would make a much more vigorous skeleton before I start.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I think people who are really in that plotting outlining mode are people who write page turners,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: people who write spy novels or supernatural adventures where you really want a relentless

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: pace of events, action, plot twists, conspiracy, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that is really the bone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That's really the skeletal structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I think folks who write that kind of book are really very much on the outlining side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think people who write what's often referred to as literary fiction, for lack

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of a better term, where it's more about sort of aura and ambiance and character development

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and experience and inner experience and inner journey and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think that group is more likely to fly by the seat of their pants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I know people who start with a blank page and just see where it's going to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm a little bit more on the plotting side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now you asked what makes something, at least in the mind of the writer, as great as it

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: can be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: For me, it's an astonishingly high percentage of it is editing as opposed to the initial

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: writing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Every hour that I spend writing new prose, like new pages, new paragraphs, stuff that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: new bits of the book, I probably spend...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, I wish I kept a count.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I wish I had one of those pieces of software that lawyers use to decide how much time I've

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: been doing this or that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I would say it's at least four or five hours and maybe as many as 10 that I spend

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: editing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so it's relentless for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: For each one hour of writing, you said?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'd say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: For a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I write because I edit and I spend just relentlessly polishing and pruning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And sometimes on the micro level of just like, does the rhythm of the sentence feel right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Do I need to carve a syllable or something so it can land?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: As micro as that to as macro as like, okay, I'm done, but the book is 750 pages long and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: it's way too bloated and I need to lop a third out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Sometimes on those two orders of magnitude and everything in between, that is an enormous

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: amount of my time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I also write music, write and record and produce music.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And there the ratio is even higher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Every minute that I spend or my band spends laying down that original audio, it's a very

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: high proportion of hours that go into just making it all hang together and sound just

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that's true of a lot of creative processes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I know it's true of sculpture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I believe it's true of woodwork.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: My dad was an amateur woodworker and he spent a huge amount of time on sanding and polishing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: at the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I think a great deal of the sparkle comes from that part of the process, any creative

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Can I ask about the psychological, the demon side of that picture?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: In the editing process, you're ultimately judging the initial piece of work and you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: judging and judging and judging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: How much of your time do you spend hating your work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: How much time do you spend in gratitude, impressed, thankful, or how good the work that you will

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: put together is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I spend almost all the time in a place that's intermediate between those, but leaning toward

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: gratitude.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I spend almost all the time in a state of optimism that this thing that I have, I like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I like quite a bit and I can make it better and better and better with every time I go

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: through it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I spend most of my time in a state of optimism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think I personally oscillate much more aggressively between those two, where I wouldn't be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to find the average.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I go pretty deep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Marvin Minsky from MIT had this advice, I guess, to what it takes to be successful in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: science and research is to hate everything you do, you've ever done in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, at least he was speaking about himself that the key to his success was to hate everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: he's ever done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I have a little Marvin Minsky there in me too, to sort of always be exceptionally self-critical,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: almost like self-critical about the work, but grateful for the chance to be able to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: do the work, if that makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Makes perfect sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But that, you know, each one of us have to strike a certain kind of balance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But back to the destruction of human civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If humans destroy ourselves in the next hundred years, what will be the most likely source,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the most likely reason that we destroy ourselves?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, let's see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Hundred years, it's hard for me to comfortably predict out that far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And it's something to give a lot more thought to, I think, than normal folks simply because

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I am a science fiction writer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I feel with the acceleration of technological progress, it's really hard to foresee out

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: more than just a few decades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, comparing today's world to that of 1921, where we are right now a century later,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: it's been so unforeseeable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I just don't know what's going to happen, particularly with exponential technologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, our intuitions reliably defeat ourselves with exponential technologies like computing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and synthetic biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And, you know, how we might destroy ourselves in the hundred year time frame might have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: everything to do with breakthroughs in nanotechnology 40 years from now and then how rapidly they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: do, as breakthroughs accelerate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But in the nearer term than I'm comfortable predicting, let's say 30 years, I would say

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the most likely route to self-destruction would be synthetic biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I always say that with the gigantic caveat and very important one that I find, and I'll

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: abbreviate synthetic biology to SYNBIO just to save us some syllables.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I believe SYNBIO offers us simply stunning promise that we would be fools to deny ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I'm not an anti-SYNBIO person by any stretch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, SYNBIO has unbelievable odds of helping us beat cancer, helping us rescue the environment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: helping us do things that we would currently find imponderable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So it's electrifying the field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But in the wrong hands, those hands either being incompetent or being malevolent, in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the wrong hands, synthetic biology to me has a much, much greater odds of leading to our

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: self-destruction than something running amok with super AI, which I believe is a real possibility

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and one we need to be concerned about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But in the 30 year timeframe, I think it's a lesser one or nuclear weapons or anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: else that I can think of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Can you explain that a little bit further?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So your concern is on the manmade versus the natural side of the pandemic front here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So we humans engineering pathogens, engineering viruses is the concern here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And maybe how do you see the possible trajectories happening here in terms of, is it malevolent

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: or is it accidents, oops, little mistakes or unintended consequences of particular actions

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that are ultimately lead to unexpected mistakes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, both of them are in danger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think the question of which is more likely has to do with two things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: One, do we take a lot of methodical, affordable, four-sided steps that we are absolutely capable

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of taking right now to first stall the risk of a bad actor infecting us with something

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that could have annihilating impacts?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And in the episode you referenced with Sam, we talked a great deal about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So do we take those steps?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if we take those steps, I think the danger of malevolent rogue actors doing a sin with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: sin bio can plummet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But it's always a question of if, and we have a bad, bad and very long track record of hitting

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the snooze bar after different natural pandemics have attacked us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So that's variable number one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Variable number two is how much experimentation and pathogen development do we as a society

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: decide is acceptable in the realms of academia, government or private industry?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if we decide as a society that it's perfectly okay for people with varying research agendas

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to create pathogens that if released could wipe out humanity, if we think that's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if that kind of work starts happening in one lab, five labs, 50 labs, 500 labs in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: one country, then 10 countries, then 70 countries or whatever, that risk of a boo-boo starts

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: rising astronomically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And this won't be a spoiler alert based on the way that I presented those two things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: but I think it's unbelievably important to manage both of those risks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The easier one to manage, although it wouldn't be simple by any stretch because it would

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: have to be something that all nations agree on, but the easier risk to manage is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of, hey guys, let's not develop pathogens that if they escaped from a lab could annihilate

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There's no line of research that justifies that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And in my view, I mean, that's the point of perspective we need to have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We'd have to collectively agree that there's no line of research that justifies that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The reason why I believe that would be a highly rational conclusion is even the highest level

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of biosafety lab in the world, biosafety lab level four, and there are not a lot of BSL

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: four labs in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Things can and have leaked out of BSL four labs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And some of the work that's been done with potentially annihilating pathogens, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: we can talk about, it's actually done at BSL three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so fundamentally any lab can leak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We have proven ourselves to be incapable of creating a lab that is utterly impervious

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to leaks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So why in the world would we create something where if God forbid it leaked, could annihilate

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: us all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And by the way, almost all of the measures that are taken in biosafety level, anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: labs are designed to prevent accidental leaks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What happens if you have a malevolent insider?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And we could talk about the psychology and the motivations of what would make a malevolent

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: insider who wants to release something annihilating in a bet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm sure that we will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But what if you have a malevolent insider?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Virtually none of the standards that go into biosafety level one, two, three, and four

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: are about preventing somebody hijacking the process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Some of them are, but they're mainly designed against accidents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They're imperfect against accidents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if this kind of work starts happening in lots and lots of labs with every lab you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: add, the odds of there being a malevolent insider naturally increase arithmetically

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: as the number of labs goes up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now on the front of somebody outside of a government academic or traditional government

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: scientific environment creating something malevolent, again, there's protections that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: we can take both at the level of syn-bio architecture, the heartening entire syn-bio ecosystem against

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: terrible things being made that we don't want to have out there by rogue actors, to early

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: detection, to lots and lots of other things that we can do to dramatically mitigate that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think we do both of those things, decide that no, we're not going to experimentally

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: make annihilating pathogens in leaky labs, and B, yes, we are going to take countermeasures

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that are going to cost a fraction of our annual defense budget to preclude their creation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think both risks get managed down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But if you take one set of precautions and not the other, then the thing that you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: not taken precautions against immediately becomes the more likely outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So can we talk about this kind of research and what's actually done and what are the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: positives and negatives of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So if we look at gain of function research and the kind of stuff that's happening in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: level three and level four BSL labs, what's the whole idea here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Is it trying to engineer viruses to understand how they behave?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You want to understand the dangerous ones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So that would be the logic behind doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so gain of function can mean a lot of different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Viewed through a certain lens, gain of function research could be what you do when you create

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: GMOs, when you create hardy strains of corn that are resistant to pesticides.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You could view that as gain of function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I'm going to refer to gain of function in a relatively narrow sense, which is actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the sense that the term is usually used, which is in some way magnifying capabilities of microorganisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to make them more dangerous, whether it's more transmissible or more deadly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And in that line of research, I'll use an example from 2011 because it's very illustrative

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and it's also very chilling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Back in 2011, two separate labs independently of one another, I assume there was some kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of communication between them, but they were basically independent projects, one in Holland

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and one in Wisconsin, did gain of function research on something called H5N1 flu.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: H5N1 is something that at least on a lethality basis makes COVID look like a kitten.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: COVID, according to the World Health Organization, as a case fatality rate somewhere between half

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a percent and 1%, H5N1 is closer to 60%, 6-0.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so that's actually even slightly more lethal than Ebola.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's a very, very, very scary pathogen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The good news about H5N1 is that it is barely, barely contagious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I believe it is in no way contagious human to human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It requires very, very, very deep contact with birds, in most cases, chickens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so if you're a chicken farmer and you spend an enormous amount of time around them

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and perhaps you get into situations in which you get a break in your skin and you're interacting

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: intensely with fowl who, as it turns out, have H5N1, that's when the jump comes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But there's no airborne transmission that we're aware of human to human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Not that it just doesn't exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think the World Health Organization did a relentless survey of the number of H5N1

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think they do it every year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I saw one 10-year series where I think it was like 500 fatalities over the course of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a decade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that's a drop in the bucket.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Kind of fun fact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I believe the typical lethality from lightning over 10 years is 70,000 deaths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So we've been getting struck by lightning, pretty low risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: H5N1 much, much lower than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What happened in these experiments is the experimenters in both cases set out to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: H5N1 that would be contagious, that could create airborne transmission.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so they basically passed it, I think in both cases, they passed it through a large

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: number of ferrets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so this wasn't like CRISPR.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There wasn't even any CRISPR back in those days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: This was relatively straightforward, you know, selecting for a particular outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And after guiding the path and passing them through, again, I believe it was a series

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of ferrets, they did in fact come up with a version of H5N1 that is capable of airborne

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: transmission.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now they didn't unleash it into the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They didn't inject it into humans to see what would happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so for those two reasons, we don't really know how contagious it might have been.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But you know, if it was as contagious as COVID, that could be a civilization threatening pathogen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And why would you do it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, the people who did it were good guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They were virologists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I believe their agenda as they explained it was much as you said, let's figure out what

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a worst case scenario might look like so we can understand it better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But my understanding is in both cases, it was done in BSL3 labs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so potential of leak, significantly non-zero, hopefully way below 1%, but significantly

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: non-zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And when you look at the consequences of an escape in terms of human lives, destruction

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of a large portion of the economy, et cetera, and you do an expected value calculation on

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: whatever fraction of 1% that was, you would come up with a staggering cost, staggering

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: expected cost for this work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So it should never have been carried out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now you might make an argument if you said, if you believed that H5N1 in nature is on

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: an inevitable path to airborne transmission, and it's only going to be a small number of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: years A. And B, if it makes that transition, there is one set of changes to its metabolic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: pathways and its genomic code and so forth, one that we have discovered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So it is going to go from point A, which is where it is right now, to point B. We have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: reliably engineered point B. That is the destination.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And we need to start fighting that right now because this is five years or less away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now that'd be a very different world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That'd be like spotting an asteroid that's coming toward the earth and is five years

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And yes, you marshal everything you can to resist that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, there's two problems with that perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The first is, and however many thousands of generations that humans have been inhabiting

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: this planet, there has never been a transmissible form of H5N1.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And influenza has been around for a very long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So there is no case for inevitability of this kind of a jump to airborne transmission.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So we're not on a freight train to that outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if there was inevitability around that, it's not like there's just one set of genetic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: code that would get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There's all kinds of different mutations that could conceivably result in that kind of an

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Unbelievable diversity of mutations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so we're not actually creating something we're inevitably going to face, but we are

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: creating something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We are creating a very powerful and unbelievably negative card and injecting it in the deck

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that nature never put into the deck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So in that case, I just don't see any moral or scientific justification for that kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And interestingly, there was quite a bit of excitement and concern about this when the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: work came out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: One of the teams was going to publish their results in science, the other in nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And there were a lot of editorials and a lot of scientists are saying this is crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And publication of those papers did get suspended.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And not long after that, there was a pause put on US government funding, NIH funding

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: on gain of function research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But both of those speed bumps were ultimately removed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Those papers did ultimately get published and that pause on funding ceased long ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And in fact, those two very projects, my understanding is resumed their funding, got their government

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: funding back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't know why Dutch projects getting NIH funding, but whatever, about a year and a

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: half ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So as far as the US government and regulators are concerned, it's all systems go for gain

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of function at this point, which I find very troubling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now, I'm a little bit of an outsider from this field, but it has echoes of the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: kind of problem I see in the AI world with autonomous weapons systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Nobody in my colleagues, my colleagues, friends, as far as I can tell people in the AI community

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: are not really talking about autonomous weapons systems as now US and China full steam ahead

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: on the development of both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that seems to be a similar kind of thing on gain of function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I have friends in the biology space and they don't want to talk about gain of function

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: publicly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that makes me very uncomfortable from an outsider perspective in terms of gain of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It makes me very uncomfortable from the insider perspective on autonomous weapons systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm not sure how to communicate exactly about autonomous weapons systems and I certainly

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: don't know how to communicate effectively about gain of function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What is the right path forward here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Should we seize all gain of function research?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Is that really the solution here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, again, I'm going to use gain of function in the relatively narrow context of what we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: discussing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You could say almost anything that you do to make biology more effective as gain of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So within the narrow confines of what we're discussing, I think it would be easy enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: for level-headed people in all of the countries, level-headed governmental people in all the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: countries that realistically could support such a program to agree, we don't want this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to happen because all labs leak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: An example that I use, I actually used in the piece I did with Sam Harris as well, is
