metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the anthrax attacks in the United States in 2001.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Talk about an example of the least likely lab leaking into the least likely place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: This was shortly after 9-11 for folks who don't remember it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It was a very, very lethal strand of anthrax that as it turned out based on the forensic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: genomic work that was done and so forth, absolutely leaked from a high-security US Army lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Probably the one at Fort Detrick in Maryland.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It might have been another one, but who cares?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It absolutely leaked from a high-security US Army lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Where did it leak to?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: This highly dangerous substance that was kept under lock and key by a very security-minded

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: organization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, it leaked to places including the Senate Majority Leader's Office, Tom Daschle's office.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think it was Senator Leahy's office, certain publications including bizarrely, The National

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Enquirer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But let's go to the Senate Majority Leader's office.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It is hard to imagine a more security-minded country than the United States two weeks after

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the 9-11 attack.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It doesn't get more security-minded than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's also hard to imagine a more security-capable organization than the United States military.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We can joke all we want about inefficiencies in the military and $24,000 wrenches and so

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: forth, but pretty capable when it comes to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: To create that level of focus and concern and competence just days after the 9-11 attack,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: something comes from the inside of our military and industrial complex and ends up in the

body.input: Is the question of whether COVID leaked from a lab?

body.input: Not even answering that question, but even asking that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the hypothetical rational national leaders watching this simple PowerPoint.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If you could put the possibility at 1% and you look at the unbelievable destructive power

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that COVID had, that should be an overwhelmingly powerful argument for excluding it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now as to whether or not that was a leak, some very, very level, I don't know enough

body.input: the pro argument of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I don't pretend to be an expert on that and I don't have a point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I just don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But what we can say is it is entirely possible for a couple of reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I believe it's the only BSL-4 in China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I could be wrong about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But it definitely had a history that alarmed very sophisticated US diplomats and others

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: who were in contact with the lab and were aware of what it was doing long before COVID

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: hit the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so there are diplomatic cables that have been declassified.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I believe one sophisticated scientist or other observer said that WIV is a ticking time bomb.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I believe it's also been pretty reasonably established that coronaviruses were a topic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of great interest at WIV.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: SARS obviously came out of China and that's a coronavirus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It would make an enormous amount of sense for it to be studied there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And there is so much opacity about what happened in the early days and weeks after the outbreak

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that's basically been imposed by the Chinese government that we just don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So it feels like a substantially or greater than 1% possibility to me looking at it from

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the outside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that's something that one could imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now we're going to the realm of thought experiment, not me decreeing this is what happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But if they're studying coronavirus at the Wuhan Institute of Virology and there is this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: precedent of gain of function research that's been done on something that is remarkably

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: uncontagious to humans, whereas we know coronavirus is contagious to humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And there is this global consensus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Certainly it was the case two or three years ago when this work might have started, there

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: seems to be this global consensus that gain of function is fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The US paused funding for a little while, but paused funding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They never said private actors couldn't do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It was just a pause of NIH funding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And then that pause was lifted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a multi-year bureaucratic failure of the entire government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: degree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think that particularly authoritarian governments are unbelievably reluctant to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to admit any fallibility and tolerate the possibility of any fallibility whatsoever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It would be necessary to definitively say X happened versus Y.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and how could we do better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of when we put our minds to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So do that on a global basis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I don't think that's irrational because the best prototype for this than I'm aware

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of isn't currently rolling out in Atherton, California, or Fairfield County, Connecticut,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: or some other wealthy place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But also there's just an unbelievable public health benefit from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: line, or because it's uncommon but unbelievably threatening like Ebola.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: J and J good in a period of just a few days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And people just feel whipsawed and they're not part of the analysis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But it's not just the whipsawing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think about this quite a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't think I have good answers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's something about the way the communication actually happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Just I don't know what it is about Anthony Fauci, for example, but I don't trust him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think that has to do, I mean, he's, he did, he's, he has an incredible background.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm sure he's a brilliant scientist and researcher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm sure he's also a great, like inside the room, policymaker and deliberator and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But you know, what makes a great leader is something about that thing that you can't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: quite describe, but being a communicator that you know, you can trust that there's an authenticity

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that's required.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I'm not sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Maybe I'm being a bit too judgmental, but I'm a huge fan of a lot of great leaders throughout

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They've communicated exceptionally well in the way that Fauci does not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think about what is effective science communication.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So you know, great leaders throughout history did not necessarily need to be great science

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: communicators.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Their leadership was in other domains, but when you're fighting the virus, you also have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to be a great science communicator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You have to be able to communicate uncertainties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You have to be able to communicate something like a vaccine that you're allowing inside

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: your body into the messiness, into the complexity of the biology system, that if we're being

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: honest, it's so complex, we'll never be able to really understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We can only desperately hope that science can give us sort of a high likelihood that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: there's no short-term negative consequences and that kind of intuition about long-term

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: negative consequences and doing our best in this battle against trillions of things that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: are trying to kill us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, being an effective communicator in that space is very difficult, but I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: about what it takes because I think there should be more science communicators that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: are effective at that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Let me ask you about something that's sort of more in the AI space that I think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that kind of goes along this thread that you've spoken about, about democratizing the technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that could destroy human civilization is from amazing work from DeepMind, AlphaFold2, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: achieved incredible performance on the protein folding problem, single protein folding problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Do you think about the use of AI in the syn-biospace of, I think the gain of function in the virus-based

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: research that you referred to, I think is natural mutations and sort of aggressively

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: mutating the virus until you get one that has this both contagious and deadly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But what about then using AI to, through simulation, be able to compute deadly viruses or any kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of biological systems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Is this something you're worried about or again, is this something you're more excited

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think computational biology is unbelievably exciting and promising field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I think when you're doing things in silica as opposed to in vivo, the dangers plummet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You don't have a critter that can leak from a leaky lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I don't see any problem with that, except I do worry about the data security dimension

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of it because if you were doing really, really interesting in silico gain of function research

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and you hit upon through a level of sophistication, we don't currently have, but synthetic biology

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: is an exponential technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So capabilities that are utterly out of reach today will be attainable in five or six years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think if you conjured up worst case genomes of viruses that don't exist in vivo anywhere,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: they're just in the computer space, but like, hey guys, this is the genetic sequence that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: would end the world, let's say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Then you have to worry about the utter hackability of every computer network we can imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Data leaks from the least likely places on the grandest possible scales have happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and continue to happen and will probably always continue to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So that would be the danger of doing the work in silico.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If you end up with a list of like, well, these are things we never want to see, that list

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: leaks and after the passage of some time, certainly couldn't be done today, but after

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the passage of some time, lots and lots of people in academic labs going all the way

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: down to the high school level are in a position to make it overly simplistic, hit print on

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a genome and have the virus bearing that genome pop out on the other end, then you've got

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: something to worry about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But in general, computational biology, I think is incredibly important, particularly because

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the crushing majority of work that people are doing with the protein folding problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and other things are about creating therapeutics, about creating things that will help us live

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: better, live longer, thrive, be more well and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The protein folding problem is a monstrous computational challenge that we seem to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: just the most glacial project on, I'm sorry, progress on for years and years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I think there's a biannual competition, I think, at which people tackle the protein

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: folding problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And DeepMind's entrant both two years ago, like in 2018 and 2020 ruled the field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so protein folding is an unbelievably important thing if you want to start thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: about therapeutics because it's the folding of the protein that tells us where the channels

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and the receptors and everything else are on that protein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And it's from that precise model, if we can get to a precise model, that you can start

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: barraging it again in silicone with thousands, tens of thousands, millions of potential therapeutics

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and see what resolves the problems, the shortcomings that a mis-shapen protein, for instance, somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: with cystic fibrosis, how might we treat that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I see nothing but good in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, let me ask you about fear and hope in this world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I tend to believe that in terms of competence and malevolence, that people who are, maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: it's in my interactions, I tend to see that, first of all, I believe that most people are

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: good and want to do good and are just better at doing good and more inclined to do good

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: on this world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And then more than that, people who are malevolent are usually incompetent at building technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I've seen this in my life that people who are exceptionally good at stuff, no matter

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: what the stuff is, tend to, maybe they discover joy in life in a way that gives them fulfillment

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and thereby does not result in them wanting to destroy the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So the better you are at stuff, whether that's building nuclear weapons or plumbing, it doesn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: matter, both, the less likely you are to destroy the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So in that sense, with many technologies, AI especially, I always think that the malevolent

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: would be far outnumbered by the ultra competent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And in that sense, the defenses will always be stronger than the offense in terms of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: people trying to destroy the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now, there's a few spaces where that might not be the case, and that's an interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: conversation where this one person who's not very competent can destroy the whole world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Perhaps Symbio is one such space because of the exponential effects of the technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I tend to believe AI is not one of those such spaces, but do you share this kind of view

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that the ultra competent are usually also the good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I absolutely share that, and that gives me a great deal of optimism that we will be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to short circuit the threat that malevolence and bio could pose to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But we need to start creating those defensive systems or defensive layers, one of which

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: we talked about far, far, far better surveillance in order to prevail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So the good guys will almost inevitably outsmart and definitely outnumber the bad guys in most

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: sort of smack downs that we can imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But the good guys aren't going to be able to exert their advantages unless they have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the imagination necessary to think about what the worst possible thing can be done by somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: whose own psychology is completely alien to their own.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So that's a tricky, tricky thing to solve for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now, in terms of whether the asymmetric power that a bad guy might have in the face of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: overwhelming numerical advantage and competence advantage that the good guys have, unfortunately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I look at something like mass shootings as an example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm sure the guy who was responsible for the Vegas shooting or the Orlando shooting or

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: any other shooting that we can imagine didn't know a whole lot about ballistics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The number of good guy citizens in the United States with guns compared to bad guy citizens,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm sure, is a crushingly, overwhelmingly high ratio in favor of the good guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But that doesn't make it possible for us to stop mass shootings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: An example is Fort Hood, 45,000 trained soldiers on that base, yet there have been two mass

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: shootings there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so there is an asymmetry when you have powerful and lethal technology that gets so

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: democratized and so proliferated in tools that are very, very easy to use, even by a

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: knucklehead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: When those tools get really easy to use by a knucklehead and they're really widespread,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: it becomes very, very hard to defend against all instances of usage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now, the good news, quote unquote, about mass shootings, if there is any, and there is some,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: is even the most brutal and carefully planning and well-armed mass shooter can only take

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: so many victims.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the same is true as there's been four instances that I'm aware of, of commercial

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: pilots committing suicide by downing their planes and taking all their passengers with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: These weren't Boeing engineers, but like an army of Boeing engineers, ultimately, were

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: not capable of preventing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But even in their case, and I'm actually not counting 9-11 and that, 9-11 is a different

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: category in my mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: These are just personally suicidal pilots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: In those cases, they only have a plane load of people that they're able to take with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If we imagine a highly plausible and imaginable future in which some bio tools that are amoral,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that could be used for good or for ill, start embodying unbelievable sophistication and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: genius in the tool, in the easier and easier and easier to make tool, all those thousands,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands of scientists years start getting embodied in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: something that maybe as simple as hitting a print button.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Even that good guy technology can be hijacked by a bad person and used in a very asymmetric

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: See, I think what happens though, as you go to the high school student from the current

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: like very specific set of labs, they're able to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: As it becomes more and more democratized, as it becomes easier and easier to do this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: kind of large scale damage with an engineered virus, the more and more there will be engineering

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of defenses against these systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Some of the things we talked about in terms of testing, in terms of collection of data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: but also in terms of at scale contact tracing or also engineering of vaccines in a matter

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of days, maybe hours, maybe minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I feel like the defenses, that's what human species seems to do, is we keep hitting the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: snooze button until there's like a storm on the horizon heading towards us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Then we start to quickly build up the defenses or the response that's proportional to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: scale of the storm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Of course, again, certain kinds of exponential threats require us to build up the defenses

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: way earlier than we usually do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That's I guess the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I ultimately am hopeful that the natural process of hitting the snooze button until

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the deadline is right in front of us will work out for quite a long time for us humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I fully agree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That's why I'm fundamentally, I may not sound like it thus far, but I'm fundamentally very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: very optimistic about our ability to short circuit this threat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Because there is, again, I'll stress, the technological feasibility and the profound

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: affordability of a relatively simple set of steps that we can take to preclude it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But we do have to take those steps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What I'm hoping to do and trying to do is inject a notion of what those steps are into

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the public conversation and do my small part to up the odds that that actually ends up

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The danger with this one is it is exponential.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think that our minds fundamentally struggle to understand exponential math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's just not something we're wired for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Our ancestors didn't confront exponential processes when they were growing up on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: savanna.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's not something that's intuitive to us and our intuitions are reliably defeated when

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: exponential processes come along.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That's issue number one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Issue number two with something like this is it only takes one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That ball only has to go into the net once and we're doomed, which is not the case with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: mass shooters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's not the case with commercial pilots running a mock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's not the case with really any threat that I can think of with the exception of nuclear

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: war that has the one bad outcome and game over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That means that we need to be unbelievably serious about these defenses and we need to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: do things that might on the surface seem like a tremendous overreaction so that we can be

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: prepared to nip anything that comes along in the bud.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I like you believe that's eminently doable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I like you believe that the good guys outnumber the bad guys in this particular one to a degree

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that probably has no precedent in history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Even the worst, worst people I'm sure in ISIS, even Osama bin Laden, even any bad guy you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: could imagine in history would be revolted by the idea of exterminating all of humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That's a low bar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The good guys completely outnumber the bad guys when it comes to this, but the asymmetry

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and the fact that one catastrophic error could lead to unbelievably consequential things

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: is what worries me here, but I too am very optimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The thing that I sometimes worry about is the fact that we haven't seen overwhelming

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: evidence of alien civilizations out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Makes me think, well, there's a lot of explanations, but one of them that worries me is that whenever

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: they get smart, they just destroy themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Oh yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, that was the most fascinating, is the most fascinating and chilling number or

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: variable in the Drake equation is L.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: At the end of it, you look out and you see one to 400 billion stars in the Milky Way

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: galaxy and we now know because of Kepler that an astonishingly high percentage of them probably

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: have habitable planets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: All the things that were unknowns when the Drake equation was originally written, like

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: how many stars have planets?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Actually back then in the 1960s when the Drake equation came along, the consensus amongst

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: astronomers was that it would be a small minority of solar systems that had planets or stars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: but now we know it's substantially all of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: How many of those stars have planets in the habitable zone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's kind of looking like 20%, like, oh my God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so L, which is how long does a civilization once it reaches technological competence continues

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to last.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That's the doozy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And you're right, it's all too plausible to think that when a civilization reaches a level

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of sophistication, that's probably just a decade or three in our future, the odds of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: it self-destructing, it just start mounting astronomically, no pun intended.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: My hope is that actually there is a lot of alien civilizations out there and what they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: figure out in order to avoid the self-destruction, they need to turn off the thing that was useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that used to be a feature now became a bug, which is the desire to colonize, to conquer

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: more land.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So they, like, there's probably ultra-intelligent alien civilizations out there that are just

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: like chilling, like on the beach with whatever your favorite alcohol beverages, but like

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: without sort of trying to conquer everything, just chilling out and maybe exploring in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: realm of knowledge, but almost like appreciating existence for its own sake versus life as

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a progression of conquering of other life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Like this kind of predator prey formulation that resulted in us humans perhaps is something

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: we have to shed in order to survive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah, that is a very plausible solution to Fermi's paradox and it's one that makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: When we look at our own lives and our own arc of technological trajectory, it's very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: very easy to imagine that in an intermediate future world of flawless VR or flawless whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: kind of simulation that we want to inhabit, it will just simply cease to be worthwhile

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to go out and expand our interstellar territory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But if we were going out and conquering interstellar territory, it wouldn't necessarily have to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: be predator or prey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I can imagine a benign but sophisticated intelligence saying, well, we're going to go to places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We're going to go to places that we can terraform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We use a different word than terra obviously, but we can turn into habitable for our particular

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: physiology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So long as that they don't house intelligent sentient creatures that would suffer from

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: our invasion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But it is easy to see a sophisticated intelligence species evolving to the point where interstellar

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: travel with its incalculable expense and physical hurdles just isn't worth it compared to what

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: could be done where one already is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So you talked about diagnostics that scales a possible solution to our future pandemics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What about another possible solution, which is kind of creating a backup copy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm actually now putting together a NAS for backup for myself for the first time, taking

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: backup of data seriously, but I forward to take the backup of human consciousness seriously

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and try to expand throughout the solar system and colonize other planets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Do you think that's an interesting solution, one of many for protecting human civilizations

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: from self-destruction, sort of humans becoming a multi-planetary species?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Oh, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, I find it electrifying, first of all, so I've got a little bit of a personal bias.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: When I was a kid, I thought there was nothing cooler than rockets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I thought there was nothing cooler than NASA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I thought there was nothing cooler than people walking on the moon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And as I grew up, I thought there was nothing more tragic than the fact that we went from

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: walking on the moon to at best getting to something like suborbital altitude.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I found that more and more depressing with the passage of decades at just the colossal

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: expense of manned space travel and the fact that it seemed that we were unlikely to ever

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: get back to the moon, let alone Mars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I have a boundless appreciation for Elon Musk for many reasons, but the fact that he

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: has put Mars on the credible agenda is one of the things that I appreciate immensely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So there's just the sort of space nerd in me that just says, God, that's cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: On a more practical level, we were talking about potentially inhabiting planets that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: aren't our own.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And we're thinking about a benign civilization that would do that in planetary circumstances

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: where we're not causing other conscious systems to suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, Mars is a place that's very promising.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There may be microbial life there, and I hope there is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if we found it, I think it would be electrifying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I think ultimately, the moral judgment would be made that the continued thriving

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of that microbial life is of less concern than creating a habitable planet to humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: which would be a project on the many thousands of years scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I don't think that that would be a greatly immoral act.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if that happened and if Mars became home to a self-sustaining group of humans that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: could survive a catastrophic mistake here on Earth, then yeah, the fact that we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a backup colony is great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if we could make more...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm sorry, not backup colony, backup copy is great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if we could make more and more such backup copies throughout the solar system by hollowing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: out asteroids and whatever else it is, maybe even Venus, we could get rid of three quarters

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of its atmosphere and turn it into a tropical paradise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think all of that is wonderful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now, whether we can make the leap from that to interstellar transportation with the incredible
