metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that's sad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And hopefully they'll keep us around, but I think it is a kind of goodbye to realizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that we're not the most special species on earth anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That's still painful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's still painful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And in terms of whether such a creation would have to be conscious, let's say, I'm not so

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Let's imagine something that can pass the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Something that passes the Turing test could, over text-based interaction in any event,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: successfully mimic a very conscious intelligence on the other end, but just be completely unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So that's a possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that if you take that up a radical step, which I think we can be permitted if we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: thinking about superintelligence, you could have something that could reason its way through

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: this is my optimization function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And in order to get to it, I've got to deal with these messy, somewhat illogical things

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that are as intelligent in relation to me as they are intelligent in relation to ants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I can trick them, manipulate them, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I know the resources I need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I need this amount of power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I need to seize control of these manufacturing resources that are robotically operated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I need to improve those robots with software upgrades and then ultimately mechanical upgrades,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: which I can affect through X, Y, and Z.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That could still be a thing that passes the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't think it's necessarily certain that that optimization function maximizing entity

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: would be conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: See, this is from a very engineering perspective because I think a lot about natural language

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: processing, all those kind of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm speaking to a very specific problem of just say the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I really think that something like consciousness is required...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: When you say reasoning, you're separating that from consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I think consciousness is part of reasoning in the sense that you will not be able to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: become super intelligent in the way that's required to be part of human society without

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: having consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Like, I really think it's impossible to separate the consciousness thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But it's hard to define consciousness when you just use that word.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Even just like the capacity...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The way I think about consciousness is the important symptoms or maybe consequences

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of consciousness, one of which is the capacity to suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I think AI will need to be able to suffer in order to become super intelligent, to feel

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the pain, the uncertainty, the doubt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The other part of that is not just the suffering, but the ability to understand that it too

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: is mortal in a sense that has a self-awareness about its presence in the world, understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that it's finite and be terrified of that finiteness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I personally think that's a fundamental part of the human condition is this fear of death

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that most of us construct an illusion around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I think AI would need to be able to really have it part of its whole essence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Every computation, every part of the thing that generates, that does both the perception

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and generates the behavior will have to have...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't know how this is accomplished, but I believe it has to truly be terrified of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: death, truly have the capacity to suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And from that, something that would be recognized to us humans as consciousness would emerge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Whether it's the illusion of consciousness, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The point is it looks a whole hell of a lot like consciousness to us humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I believe that AI, when you ask it, will also say that it is conscious in the full

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: sense that we say that we're conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And all of that I think is fully integrated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You can't separate it to the idea of the paperclip maximizer that sort of ultra rationally would

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: be able to destroy all humans because it's really good at accomplishing a simple objective

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: function that doesn't care about the value of humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It may be possible, but the number of trajectories to that are far outnumbered by the trajectories

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that create something that is conscious, something that appreciable beauty creates beautiful

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: things in the same way that humans can create beautiful things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And ultimately, the sad, destructive path for that AI would look a lot like just better

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: humans than these cold machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I would say, of course, the cold machines that lack consciousness, the philosophical

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: zombies make me sad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But also what makes me sad is just things that are far more powerful and smart and creative

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: than us too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Because then in the same way that Alpha Zero becoming a better chess player than the best

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of humans, even starting with Deep Blue, but really with Alpha Zero, that makes me sad

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: One of the most beautiful games that humans ever created that used to be seen as demonstrations

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of the intellect, which is chess and go in other parts of the world have been solved

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: by AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So that makes me quite sad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And it feels like the progress of that is just pushing on forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Oh, it makes me sad too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And to be perfectly clear, I absolutely believe that artificial consciousness is entirely

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that's not something I rule out at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the neural states and the amount of neurotransmitters that are going between every synapse in a

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: particular person's mind, could you replicate that in silica at some reasonably distant

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: point in the future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And then you'd have a consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: piracy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So Napster came along and was a service that enabled people to get near unlimited access

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to most songs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, truly obscure things could be very hard to find on Napster, but most songs with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a relatively simple one-click ability to download those songs that have the MP3s on their hard

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: drives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But there was a lot that was very messy about the Napster experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You might download a really god-awful recording of that song.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You may download a recording that actually wasn't that song where some prankster putting

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: it up to sort of mess with people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You could struggle to find the song that you're looking for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You could end up finding yourself connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It was peer-to-peer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You might randomly find yourself connected to somebody in Bulgaria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It doesn't have a very good internet connection, so you might wait 19 minutes only for it to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: snap, et cetera, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Our argument to... Well, actually, let's start with how that hit the music labels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The music labels had been in a very, very comfortable position for many, many decades

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of essentially having monopoly, being the monopoly providers of a certain subset of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: artists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Any given label was a monopoly provider of the artists and the recordings that they owned,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and they could sell it at what turned out to be tremendously favorable rates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: In the late year of the CD, you were talking close to $20 for a compact disc that might

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: have one song that you were crazy about and simply needed to own that might actually be

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: glued to 17 other songs that you found to be sure crap.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The music industry had used the fact that it had this unbelievable leverage and profound

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: pricing power to really get music lovers to the point that they felt very, very misused

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: by the entire situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now along comes Napster, and music sales start getting gutted with extreme rapidity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The reaction of the music industry to that was one of shock and absolute fury, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: is understandable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Industries do get gutted all the time, but I struggle to think of an analog of an industry

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that got gutted that rapidly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We could say that passenger train service certainly got gutted by airlines, but that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: was a process that took place over decades and decades and decades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It wasn't something that happened, really started showing up in the numbers in a single

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: digit number of months and started looking like an existential threat within a year or

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The music industry is quite understandably in a state of shock and fury.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Don't blame them for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But then their reaction was catastrophic, both for themselves and almost for people

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: like us who were trying to do the cowboy in the white hat thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Our response to the music industry was, look, what you need to do to fight piracy, you can't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: put the genie back in the bottle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You can't switch off the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Even if you all shut your eyes and wish very, very, very hard, the internet is not going

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: away and these peer-to-peer technologies are genies out of the bottle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If you, God, don't, whatever you do, don't shut down Napster because if you do, suddenly

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that technology is going to splinter into 30 different nodes that you'll never ever

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: be able to shut off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What you suggested to them is like, look, what you want to do is to create a massively

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: better experience to piracy, something that's way better, that you sell at a completely

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: reasonable price and this is what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Don't just give people access to that very limited number of songs that they happen to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: have acquired and paid for or pirated and have on their hard drive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Give them access to all of the music in the world for a simple low price.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Obviously, that doesn't sound like a crazy suggestion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't think to anybody's ears today because that is how the majority of music is now being

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: consumed online.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But in doing that, you're going to create a much, much better option to this crappy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: rickety, buggy process of acquiring MP3s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now, unfortunately, the music industry was so angry about Napster and so forth that for

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: essentially three and a half years, they folded their arms, stamped their feet and boycotted

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So, they basically gave people who were fervently passionate about music and were digitally

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: modern, they gave them basically one choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If you want to have access to digital music, we, the music industry, insist that you steal

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: it because we are not going to sell it to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What that did is it made an entire generation of people morally comfortable with swiping

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the music because they felt quite pragmatically, well, they're not giving me any choice here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's like a 20-year-old violating the 21 drinking age.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If they do that, they're not going to feel like felons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They're going to be like, this is an unreasonable law and I'm skirting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So, they make a whole generation of people morally comfortable with swiping music, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: also technically adept at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: When they did shut down Napster and even trickier tools and like tweakier tools like Kazaa and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: so forth came along, people just figured out how to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So, by the time they finally, grudgingly, it took years, allowed us to release this experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that we were quite convinced would be better than piracy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We had this enormous hole had been dug where lots of people said, music is a thing that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: is free and that's morally okay and I know how to get it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So, streaming took many, many, many more years to take off and become the gargantuan thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the juggernaut it is today, than would have happened if they'd made, you know, pivoted

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to let's sell a better experience as opposed to demand that people want digital music,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: steal it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Like what lessons do we draw from that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Because we're probably in the midst of living through a bunch of similar situations in different

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: domains currently, which we don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There's a lot of things in this world that are really painful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Like, I mean, I don't know if you can draw perfect parallels, but fiat money versus cryptocurrency,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: there's a lot of currently people in power who are kind of very skeptical about cryptocurrency,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: although that's changing, but it's arguable it's changing way too slowly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There's a lot of people making that argument where there should be a complete like coin

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: base and all this stuff switched to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There's a lot of other domains that where a pivot, like if you pivot now, you're going

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to win big, but you don't pivot because you're stubborn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so, I mean, is this just the way that companies are?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Companies succeeds initially and then it grows and there's a huge number of employees and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: managers that don't have the guts or the institutional mechanisms to do the pivot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Is that just the way of companies?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, I think what happens, I'll use the case of the music industry, there was an economic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: model that it put food on the table and paid for marble lobbies and seven and even eight

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: figure executive salaries for many, many decades, which was the physical collection of music.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And then you start talking about something like unlimited streaming and it seems so ephemeral

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: one like such a long shot that people start worrying about cannibalizing their own business

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and they lose sight of the fact that something illicit is cannibalizing their business at

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: an extraordinarily fast rate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so if they don't do it themselves, they're doomed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, we used to put slides in front of these folks, this is really funny, where we

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: said, okay, let's assume Rhapsody, we want it to be 9.99 a month and we want it to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: 12 months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So it's $120 a year from the budget of a music lover.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And then we were also able to get reasonably accurate statistics that showed how many CDs

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: per year the average person who bothered to collect music, which was not all people actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: bought and it was overwhelmingly clear that the average CD buyer spends a hell of a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: less than $120 a year on music.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: This is a revenue expansion, blah, blah, blah, but all they could think of, and I'm not saying

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: this in a pejorative or patronizing way, I don't blame them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They'd grown up in this environment for decades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: All they could think of was the incredible margins that they had on a CD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And they would say, well, if this CD, by the mechanism that you guys are proposing, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: CD that I'm selling for $17.99, somebody would need to stream those songs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We were talking about a penny a play back then, it's less than that now that the record

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: labels get paid, but would have to stream songs from that 1,799 times, it's never going

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So they were just sort of stuck in the model of this, but it's like, no, dude, but they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: going to spend money on all this other stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I think people get very hung up on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, another example is really the taxi industry was not monolithic, like the music

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: labels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There was a whole bunch of fleets and a whole bunch of cities, very, very fragment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's an imperfect analogy, but nonetheless, imagine if the taxi industry writ large upon

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: seeing Uber said, oh my God, people want to be able to hail things easily, cheaply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They don't want to mess with cash.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They want to know how many minutes it's going to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They want to know the fare in advance, and they want a much bigger fleet than what we've

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: got.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So if the taxi industry had rolled out something like that with the branding of yellow taxis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: universally known and kind of loved by Americans and expanded their fleet in a necessary manner,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't think Uber or Lyft ever would have gotten a foothold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But the problem there was that real economics in the taxi industry wasn't with fares.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It was with the scarcity of medallions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so the taxi fleets, in many cases, owned gazillions of medallions whose value came

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: from their very scarcity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So they simply couldn't pivot to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So you think you end up having these vested interests with economics that aren't necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: visible to outsiders who get very, very reluctant to disrupt their own model, which is why it

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: ends up coming from the outside so frequently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So you know what it takes to build a successful startup, but you're also an investor in a

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: lot of successful startups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Let me ask for advice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What do you think it takes to build a successful startup by way of advice?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Well, I think it starts, I mean, everything starts and even ends with the founder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so I think it's really, really important to look at the founders' motivations and their

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: sophistication about what they're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: In almost all cases that I'm familiar with and have thought hard about, you've had a

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: founder who was deeply, deeply inculcated in the domain of technology that they were

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: taking on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Now, what's interesting about that is you could say, no, wait, how is that possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Because there's so many young founders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: When you look at young founders, they're generally coming out of very nascent emerging fields

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of technology, where simply being present and accounted for and engaged in the community

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: for a period of even months is enough time to make them very, very deeply inculcated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, you look at Mark Andreessen and Netscape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Mark had been doing visual web browsers when Netscape had been founded for what, a year

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and a half?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But he'd created the first one in Mosaic when he was an undergrad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the commercial internet was pre-nascent in 1994 when Netscape was founded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So there's somebody who's very, very deep in their domain, Mark Zuckerberg also, social

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: networking, very deep in his domain, even though it was nascent at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Lots of people doing crypto stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, 10 years ago, even seven or eight years ago, by being a really, really vehement

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and engaged participant in the crypto ecosystem, you could be an expert in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: You look, however, at more established industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Take Salesforce.com.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Salesforce automation, pretty mature field when it got started.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Who's the executive and the founder?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Mark Benioff, who has spent 13 years at Oracle and was an investor in Siebel Systems, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: ended up being Salesforce's main competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So more established, you need the entrepreneur to be very, very deep in the technology and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the culture of the space because you need that entrepreneur, that founder, to have just

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: an unbelievably accurate intuitive sense for where the puck is going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that only comes from being very deep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So that is factor number one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the next thing is that that founder needs to be charismatic and or credible or ideally

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: both in exactly the right ways to be able to attract a team that is bought into that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: vision and is bought into that founder's intuitions being correct and not just the team, obviously,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: but also the investors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So it takes a certain personality type to pull that off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the next thing I'm still talking about the founder is a relentlessness and indeed

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a monomania to put this above things that might rationally, should perhaps rationally

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: supersede it for a period of time to just relentlessly pivot when pivoting is called

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: for and it's always called for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Think of even very successful companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: How many times did Facebook pivot?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: News Feed was something that was completely alien to the original version of Facebook

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and came foundationally important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: How many times did Google, how many times at any given, how many times has Apple pivoted?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That founder energy and DNA when the founder moves on the DNA that's been inculcated with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: a company has to have that relentlessness and that ability to pivot and pivot and pivot

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: without being worried about sacred cows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And then the last thing I'll say about the founder before I get to the rest of the team

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and that'll be mercifully brief is the founder has to be obviously a really great hirer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: but just important a very good firer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And firing is a horrific experience for both people involved in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It is a wrenching emotional experience and being good at realizing when this particular

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: person is damaging the interests of the company and the team and the shareholders and having

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: the intestinal fortitude to have that conversation and make it happen is something that most

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: people don't have in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And it's something that needs to be developed in most people or maybe some people have it

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: naturally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But without that ability, that will take an A plus organization into B minus range very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: very quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so that's all what needs to be present in the founder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Can I just say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: How damn good you are, Rob.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That was brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: The one thing that was kind of really kind of surprising to me is having a deep technical

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: knowledge because I think the way you expressed it, which is that allows you to be really

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: honest with the capabilities of what's possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Of course, you're often trying to do the impossible, but in order to do the impossible, you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to be quote unquote impossible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But you have to be honest with what is actually possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And it doesn't necessarily have to be the technical competence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: It's got to be, in my view, just a complete immersion in that emerging market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so I can imagine there are a couple of people out there who have started really good

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: crypto projects who themselves are right in the code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But they're immersed in the culture and through the culture and a deep understanding of what's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: happening and what's not happening, they can get a good intuition of what's possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But the very first higher, I mean, a great way to solve that is to have a technical co-founder

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and dual founder companies have become extremely common for that reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And if you're not doing that and you're not the technical person, but you are the founder,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: you've got to be really great at hiring a very damn good technical person very, very

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Can I, on the founder, ask you, is it possible to do this alone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There's so many people giving advice on saying that it's impossible to do the first few steps,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: not impossible, but much more difficult to do it alone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: If we were to take the journey, say, especially in the software world where there's not significant

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: investment required for it to build something up, is it possible to go to a prototype, to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: something that essentially works and already has a huge number of customers alone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There are lots and lots of lone founder companies out there that have made an incredible difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I'm not certainly putting Rhapsody in the league of Spotify.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: We were too early to be Spotify, but we did an awful lot of innovation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And then after the company sold and ended up in the hands of real networks and MTV, got

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to millions of subs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I was a lone founder and I studied Arabic and Middle Eastern history undergrad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So I definitely wasn't very, very technical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But yeah, lone founders can absolutely work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the advantage of a lone founder is you don't have the catastrophic potential of a

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: falling out between founders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Two founders who fall out with each other badly can rip a company to shreds because

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: they both have an enormous amount of equity, an enormous amount of power, and the capital

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: structure is a result of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: They both have an enormous amount of moral authority with the team as a result of each

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: having that founder role.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I have witnessed over the years many, many situations in which companies have been

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: shredded or have suffered near fatal blows because of a falling out between founders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And the more founders you add, the more risky that becomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I don't think there should ever almost, I mean, you never say never, but multiple founders

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: beyond two is such an unstable and potentially treacherous situation that I would never,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: ever recommend going beyond two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: But I do see value in the non-technical sort of business and market and outside-minded

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: founder teaming up with the technical founder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: There is a lot of merit to that, but there's a lot of danger in that, lest those two blow

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: apart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Was it lonely for you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Unbelievably.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And that's the drawback.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: I mean, if you're a lone founder, there is no other person that you can sit down with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and tackle problems and talk them through who has precisely or nearly precisely your alignment

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: of interests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Your most trusted board member is likely an investor and therefore, at the end of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: day, has the interest of preferred stock in mind, not common stock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Your most trusted VP, who might own a very significant stake in the company, doesn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: own anywhere near your stake in the company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And so their long-term interests may well be in getting the right level of experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and credibility necessary to peel off and start their own company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Or their interests might be aligned with jumping ship and setting up with a different company,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: whether it's a rival or one in a completely different space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: So yeah, being a lone founder is a spectacularly lonely thing, and that's a major downside

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: What about mentorship?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Because you're a mentor to a lot of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Can you find an alleviation to that loneliness in the space of ideas with a good mentor?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: With a good mentor, like a mentor who's mentoring you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Yeah, you can, a great deal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: Particularly if it's somebody who's been through this very process and has navigated it successfully

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: and cares enough about you and your well-being to give you beautifully unvarnished advice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: that can be a huge, huge thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: That can assuage things a great deal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rob Reid: The Existential Threat of Engineered Viruses and Lab Leaks | Lex Fridman Podcast #193

body.input: And I had a board member who was not an investor, who basically played that role for me to a
