metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and I probably relate to the artists who,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: so many of the artists I work with suffer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: so many artists suffer because that's part of what makes an artist great

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: is their level of sensitivity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: that the same thing that makes an artist uncomfortable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: other people don't feel at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The time you were depressed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: what was the darkest moment of your life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: What took you there? How did you get out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It was triggered by a person making a comment

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: about something to do with work that didn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It was like to anyone else, they would hear that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and it would just be like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: okay, we'll deal with it next week, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: But for some reason I took it in a way that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I felt like the rug had been pulled out from under me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Even beyond the rational part of it, of understanding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: even after the problem that came up was solved,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: it somehow undermined something in me

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and made me feel very vulnerable in a way that I hadn't felt before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And it spiraled. How did you get out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I did a lot of different kinds of therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Starting with alternative therapies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I was seeing, I would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: between seven and eight doctors and or therapists a week.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Acupuncture, talk therapy, herbs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: any possible modality. I tried everything for a long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And nothing seemed to have an impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And then finally, I'm wary of taking any Western medicine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I'm not a drug taker or drinker or partier in any way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And I found a psychopharmacologist who was a psychic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: But because she was a psychic, I was okay to see her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I'll listen to a psychic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: but I'm not going to listen to a psychopharmacologist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: But the fact that she had the psychic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: that made her fit into my worldview.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And she recommended antidepressant,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: which went terribly wrong in the first night that I took it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And then that set me on a journey of looking for the right antidepressant,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: which was a long and painful process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: What the heck of a journey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Every one that I took made me sick. Everyone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And then finally, I don't know, five months later, six months later,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I found the magic one that worked for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And it shifted me out of the depression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I took it for, I can't remember, six months or a year,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and then weaned off and was okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And then I had another event some years later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I think I took it again for a short period of time and got out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And I've not needed it since.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Were you able to kind of introspect the triggers that led to the events?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Or is it random events of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I think it's more that because of the way that I grew up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I never had to deal with much controversy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And when I was challenged, I didn't have any ability to deal with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It's like, you know, Jonathan Haidt talks about, it's like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: So you've actually also mentioned like business sometimes gives you stress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: So this was business related stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Yeah, it was a business related thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It just made me feel bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: One of the sadder things about art and music is that it's often interleaved with business folk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I suppose that's the way of the world if you have a capitalist system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: but it makes that business folks rubbing up against artists can sometimes destroy a fragile mind and soul.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: To me, like one of the best representations of an artist, honestly, is Johnny Ive, the designer from Apple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And he's just so fragile with his ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And you talked about like when he has ideas, he really wouldn't show it to Steve Jobs or anybody

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: except for the small design team because he was so nervous that it would break.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Give it a chance. Give it a chance to grow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And it seems like the outside world, business people, PR people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: people have not lost themselves in the passion of creating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: but instead are kind of representing or like making deals, all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: They can kind of trample on those little ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And it's sad to see. It's really heartbreaking to see because you know how much trampling there's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It's one of the main jobs. My job as a record producer is to keep the voices away from the artist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: from all the people who are really on their side but don't know, whether it be people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: anyone on the business side who doesn't make things, they're excited to do their part.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: They're excited. When you deliver the art that you make to me, then we can start the project.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: But there's nothing to sell if the art doesn't happen in the right way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And it has to be protected. And it can't happen on the same kind of a timetable that business can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It's just a different thing. Art doesn't come in a quarterly way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And that doesn't apply just to music or it applies to art, it applies to all creative pursuits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: This is generally the case at MIT. It's just there's the administration,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and then there is the professors and students. And the professors and students are the creative folk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: They create stuff, they dream, they have wild ideas that go on tangents and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: They have hopes and they go with those and they get on these weird passionate pursuits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And then the administration can often just trample on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And they set up bars in all kinds of ways that you think you're not actually hurting, but you really are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And I won't mention why, but because this happens to everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And I have a large amount of leverage at MIT now, but even I get a little bit of pressure in such stupid ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Be careful. Be careful. We really want your career to succeed. Be careful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And that little pressure to an artist, do you want to go acapella? Do you want to do a country record?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Be careful. You're already a superstar. Be careful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And then in that way, you kind of push people like flock of fish into one fish tank where they're all the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And it's sad to see. And obviously in the modern world, there's nice mechanisms to protect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: to let artists flourish a little bit more because they get to put themselves to the world and get a little bit more confidence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: maybe different funding mechanisms, all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: But it's a tremendous problem that the voices that don't understand interfering with the process is huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The other side of it is in success, there can be a lack of reality where all of the people around the successful person

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: just tell them everything they do is great. And then they don't have anything to bump up against anymore,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: they don't have a realistic sense of how things work or how things measure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: So both sides are really important, both avoiding the voices getting in the way

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and having a trusted group of a sangha, a group of people who can say, I don't know if that's as good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: You can still say, I don't care what you think, that's fine. But it helps to hear it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It helps to have, if someone who you respect tells you something isn't good enough, it's helpful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: When you know it comes from a place of love, when it comes from a place of wisdom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And not from a place of fear, not from a place of, oh, this doesn't sound like it's going to do as well as your last thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: That's not the point. The point is on this quest for greatness, are you living up to your ability?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: By the way, is there something interesting to say about your worldview?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Because you mentioned psychic and sort of the ways we can be healthy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: the ways we can grow and how much maybe medicine or science has the answers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Is there some interesting way to describe that worldview?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I would just say I'm open-minded. I believe anything's possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And if I was going to trust in any practical information, it would be something thousands of years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: There's wisdom in that history. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It's more tested. It's not always right, but at least it's been somewhat tested.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Well, science is also tested.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The thing I'm a little bit skeptical of sometimes is just the hubris that often comes with the modern, with the latest, the newest,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: this feeling like you figured it all out. Everything that's been done in the past has no wisdom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And we basically solved every problem. There's nothing else to be solved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I mean, that's the defining characteristic of any age is like we've solved all the problems there are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: we have the final answers, and our parents are all stupid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: That kind of energy. Yeah. You have to be extremely, extremely careful with that when it talks about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: when you think about something as complex as the human body or the human mind, you have to be very, very careful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I believe we know close to nothing. Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Close to nothing. That's about anything. About anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: That place of humility is a good place to start to figure it all out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And in the end, we'll still know almost nothing. Yeah. I don't think we need to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It's like we need to see what works. So we need to see what works for us. It's interesting to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I know on the art side, knowing how it works isn't what makes it work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The magic of it isn't how it works. The magic is the magic. And the magic happens in a way that's intuitive

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and accidental at times or incidental where you're trying many things and all of a sudden something works

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and you don't know why. And it's okay not to know why. It doesn't really matter why,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: as long as it does the thing that you want it to do, whatever that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Yeah, that's so weird. When you know the components, you still... Yeah, the magic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: What's the magic? Where is the magic? We know the components for stuff I care about, artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: We know the components of a powerful computing machinery. Where does consciousness come from?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: What is that? Where does the brilliant moments of insight come from? What's that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Even in simple games of chess or in simple... Where do those breakthrough ideas of taking the big risk

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: that doesn't make any sense and then all of a sudden it becomes something beautiful?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Yeah, we don't need to understand why. It just happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It just happens. And often the things that end up breaking through don't break through in the way we thought

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: or turn out to be a third iteration of something that we thought was an entirely different thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: We don't know. And I think if we embrace that not knowing, we'll have a healthier experience going through life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: You made a lot... It's not just music, everything. Rearranging the chairs, the furniture as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: You've done, like I said, the documentary, I guess you would say, with Paul McCartney.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And you've done a podcast yourself, a broken record podcast, and you've done conversation too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: So what have you learned from that process about the art of conversation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: And also maybe what advice would you give to this, to me about what to do with conversation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: What is interesting to you about conversation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: One of the things that I like is to not feel like there's any stakes or that it's actually...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Almost that it's not happening. Like the fact that when I came in, you were setting up cameras made it less good for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I knew that that would impact the conversation in a negative way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The best version of it would be if we didn't see the cameras and we didn't see any technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: and we were just sitting at this table having a conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Maybe even if we were mic'd beforehand, it would be okay if it was necessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: But then we were just sitting here having a conversation, no people in the room, nothing, and feeling like we're just having a conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I feel like it would get closer to the relaxed feeling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Same thing we do in the studios. You've heard of red light fever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: When artists get nervous, they play a song great and then the tape starts rolling and they can't play it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: We're all to some degree like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: When you were with Paul McCartney, were you cognizant of cameras?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: We had the room black. Everybody who was working there was dressed in black.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Everything was invisible. We were lit in a way where...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Even though there were probably 20 people, between 12 and 20 people working in the room,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: within three minutes of starting the conversation, Paul and I were alone in the room.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: That was the feeling. On occasion, you'd hear a noise and it would be weird.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: We also had nobody was allowed to wear shoes because we were trying to create this intimate space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I know from in the recording studio, when we're recording, if even one person is there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: that's just watching and not working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I'm usually there and an engineer is there technically making it happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: If anyone else is in the room, it's different because then it goes from this moment where the person is doing a performance

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: to the sense or where the person is feeling something internally and we're capturing it

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: to the other version is they're performing for someone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It's so interesting. To push back the alternatives here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: One, about the third person, not to make people self-conscious, but I find that I'm so torn on that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: because sometimes when that person, Evan is in the room here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: He's been in the room before. He's a huge fan of yours, by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: He'll nod. He'll get excited. You can see that nodding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: For some reason for me, he's like, yeah, you get excited together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: That third person can be a really special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Having an audience when it's a friend or somebody that has that love in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It depends on the performer. Some people really thrive in front of an audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: You're saying you like that simple intimacy of everything dissipates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I like the reality of it not being it. I want it to be as far from a performance as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I'll tell you a story. A story that just happened and it was viewed as kind of a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: it seemed uncool in the moment to the person that it happened to. It wasn't at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: We were recording New Chili Peppers album, which is coming out, I think, any day now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: I don't know what today's date is, but maybe by the time this airs, it will be out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The band was playing in the studio and it was ripping because they're incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: One of the members walked through the control room after a particularly great performance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The engineer said, wow, that solo is really great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: The person who heard this said, please don't say that and walked away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: It just changed this feeling of we're in this place where we're doing this thing and there is no outside world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: We're doing this for us. We're going as deep as we can for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: As soon as there's an acknowledgement to someone else, in a way, it breaks the concentration of being inside of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: That's so well told. Something about saying, wow, that solo is great, it reminds you that there's an outside world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: but I feel like there's a way to enter the inside world as an audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: You just have to do that. It matters what you say. It matters how you look.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: There's these generic compliments, not generic, but they sound in the way an outside world would interact

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: as opposed to that creative thing where you're dancing around the fire together or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Actually, I can tell you there's another interesting one that happened to me and I didn't know this until I saw the film of it,

body.input: which was a strange one. We were recording with the Avett Brothers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Rubin: Legendary Music Producer | Lex Fridman Podcast #275

body.input: Such a great voice. So beautiful.

body.input: My hopes and my doubts, the rings on my fingers and the keys to my house with no hard feelings.

body.input: And now, here's my conversation with Eric Brinjalsson.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is our inability to understand the exponential function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is important to understand?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, that quote, I remember posting that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's actually a reprise of something Andy McAfee and I said

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the second machine age,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but I posted it in early March

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: when COVID was really just beginning to take off,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and I was really scared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There were actually only a couple dozen cases,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: maybe less at that time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but they were doubling every like two or three days,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and I could see, oh my God, this is gonna be a catastrophe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and it's gonna happen soon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but nobody was taking it very seriously,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or not a lot of people were taking it very seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In fact, I remember I did my last

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in-person conference that week.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I was flying back from Las Vegas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and I was the only person on the plane wearing a mask,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and the flight attendant came over to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: She looked very concerned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: She kinda put her hands on my shoulder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: She was touching me all over, which I wasn't thrilled about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and she goes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: do you have some kind of anxiety disorder?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Are you okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I was like, no, it's because of COVID.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: This is early March.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Early March, but I was worried because I knew I could see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or I suspected, I guess, that doubling would continue,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and it did, and pretty soon we had

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: thousands of times more cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Most of the time when I use that quote,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I try to, it's motivated by more optimistic things

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like Moore's Law and the wonders

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of having more computer power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but in either case, it can be very counterintuitive.

body.input: I mean, if you walk for 10 minutes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's the way our physical world works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's the way our brains are wired,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but if something doubles for 10 times as long,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and after 20, it's a billion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: After 30, it's a, no, sorry, after 20, it's a million.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: After 30, it's a billion, and pretty soon after that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it just gets to these numbers that you can barely grasp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Our world is becoming more and more exponential,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: mainly because of digital technologies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: so more and more often our intuitions are out of whack,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and that can be good in the case of things creating wonders,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but it can be dangerous in the case of viruses

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Like, is there spaces where it does apply

body.input: and where it doesn't?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: How are we supposed to build an intuition

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Well, you can learn the math,

body.input: but the truth is our brains, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: tend to learn more from experiences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: so we just start seeing it more and more often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So, hanging around Silicon Valley,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: hanging around AI and computer researchers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I see this kind of exponential growth a lot more frequently,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and I'm getting used to it, but I still make mistakes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I still underestimate some of the progress

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and how rapidly natural language has improved,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but I think that as the world becomes more exponential,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The danger is that we may make some mistakes

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: about how the world works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Well, the weird thing is it always kind of looks linear

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that a couple of dozen of COVID cases

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: could become thousands or tens or hundreds of thousands

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of them in a month,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it makes sense once you just do the math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I think Elon tries to do that a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You know, in fairness, I think he also benefits

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: from hanging out in Silicon Valley

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and he's experienced it in a lot of different applications.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So, you know, it's not as much of a shock to him anymore,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but that's something we can all learn from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In my own life, I remember one of my first experiences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: really seeing it was when I was a grad student

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and my advisor asked me to plot the growth of computer power

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the US economy in different industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And there are all these, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: exponentially growing curves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I was like, holy shit, look at this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In each industry, it was just taking off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And, you know, you didn't have to be a rocket scientist

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to extend that and say, wow, this means that

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: this was in the late 80s and early 90s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that, you know, if it goes anything like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we're gonna have orders of magnitude more computer power

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than we did at that time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And of course we do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So, you know, when people look at Moore's law,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they often talk about it as just,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: so the exponential function is actually a stack of S-curves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So basically it's you milk or whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: take the most advantage of a particular little revolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and then you search for another revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it's basically revolution stack on top of revolutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Do you have any intuition on how the heck humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: keep finding ways to revolutionize things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Well, first, let me just unpack that first point

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that I talked about exponential curves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but no exponential curve continues forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's been said that if anything can't go on forever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: eventually it will stop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And- That's very profound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's very profound, but it seems that a lot of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: don't appreciate that half of it as well either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that's why all exponential functions

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: eventually turn into some kind of S-curve

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or stop in some other way, maybe catastrophically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that's happened with COVID as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, it was, it went up and then it sort of, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: at some point it starts saturating the pool of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to be infected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's a standard epidemiological model

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that's based on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it's beginning to happen with Moore's law

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or different generations of computer power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It happens with all exponential curves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The remarkable thing is you elude in the second part

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of your question is that we've been able to come up

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: with a new S-curve on top of the previous one

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and do that generation after generation

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: with new materials, new processes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and just extend it further and further.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I don't think anyone has a really good theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: about why we've been so successful in doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's great that we have been,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and I hope it continues for some time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but it's, you know, one beginning of a theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is that there's huge incentives when other parts

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of the system are going on that clock speed

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of doubling every two to three years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: If there's one component of it that's not keeping up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then the economic incentives become really large

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to improve that one part.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It becomes a bottleneck,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and anyone who can do improvements in that part

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: can reap huge returns so that the resources

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: automatically get focused on whatever part

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of the system isn't keeping up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Do you think some version of the Moore's law will continue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Some version, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, one version that has become more important,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: something I call Coomy's law,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: which is named after John Coomy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: who I should mention was also my college roommate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but he identified the fact that energy consumption

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: has been declining by a factor of two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And for most of us, that's more important, you know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The new iPhones came out today as we're recording this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I'm not sure when you're gonna make it available.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Very soon after this, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And for most of us, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: having the iPhone be twice as fast, you know, it's nice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but having it the battery life longer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that would be much more valuable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And the fact that a lot of the progress in chips now

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is reducing energy consumption

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is probably more important for many applications

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than just the raw speed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Other dimensions of Moore's law are in AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: machine learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Those tend to be very parallelizable functions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: especially deep neural nets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so instead of having one chip,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you can have multiple chips or you can have a GPU,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a graphic processing unit that goes faster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And now special chips designed for machine learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like tensor processing units, each time you switch,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: there's another 10X or 100X improvement

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: above and beyond Moore's law.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So I think that the raw silicon

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: isn't improving as much as it used to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but these other dimensions are becoming important,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: more important, and we're seeing progress in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I don't know if you've seen the work by OpenAI

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: where they show the exponential improvement

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of the training of neural networks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: just literally in the techniques used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So that's almost like the algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's fascinating to think like, can I actually continue

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: us figuring out more and more tricks

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: on how to train networks faster and faster?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The progress has been staggering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: As you look at image recognition, as you mentioned,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think it's a function of at least three things

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that are coming together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: One, we just talked about faster chips,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: not just Moore's law, but GPUs, TPUs, and other technologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The second is just a lot more data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, we are awash in digital data today

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in a way we weren't 20 years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Photography, I'm old enough to remember,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it used to be chemical, and now everything is digital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I took probably 50 digital photos yesterday.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I wouldn't have done that if it was chemical,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and we have the internet of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and all sorts of other types of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: When we walk around with our phone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it's just broadcasting a huge amount of digital data

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that can be used as training sets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then last but not least, as they mentioned at OpenAI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: there have been significant improvements in the techniques.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The core idea of deep neural nets

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: has been around for a few decades,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but the advances in making it work more efficiently

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: have also improved a couple of orders of magnitude or more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So you multiply together,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a hundred-fold improvement in computer power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a hundred-fold or more improvement in data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a hundred-fold improvement in techniques

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of software and algorithms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and soon you're getting into a million-fold improvement

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that's going to be a huge step forward

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in getting into million-fold improvements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You know, somebody brought this up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: this idea with GPT-3 that it's,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: so it's trained in a self-supervised way

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: on basically internet data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that's one of the, I've seen arguments made

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that seem to be pretty convincing

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that the bottleneck there is going to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: how much data there is on the internet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: which is a fascinating idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: out of human-generated data to train on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's a-

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I know, we may get to the point where it's consumed

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: basically all of human knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or all digitized human knowledge, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that will be the bottleneck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But the interesting thing with bottlenecks

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is people often use bottlenecks as a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to argue against exponential growth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think part of his genius was with the electric cars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Before he came along,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141
