metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and risk taking, which is what Elon practices,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, to the chagrin of perhaps investors or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It requires guts and risk taking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It also requires rethinking what you're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think way too many people are unimaginative,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: intellectually lazy, and when they take AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they basically say, what are we doing now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: How can we make a machine do the same thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Maybe we'll save some costs, we'll have less labor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And yeah, it's not necessarily the worst thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the world to do, but it's really not leading

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to a quantum change in the way you do things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: When Jeff Bezos said, hey, we're gonna use the internet

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to change how bookstores work and we're gonna use technology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: he didn't go and say, okay, let's put a robot cashier

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: where the human cashier is and leave everything else alone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That would have been a very lame way

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to automate a bookstore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: He went from soup to nuts and said, let's just rethink it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We get rid of the physical bookstore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We have a warehouse, we have delivery,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we have people order on a screen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And everything was reinvented.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that's been the story of these general purpose

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: technologies all through history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And in my books, I write about like electricity

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and how for 30 years, there was almost no productivity gain

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: from the electrification of factories a century ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Now it's not because electricity

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: wouldn't be useless technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We all know how awesome electricity is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's because at first, they really didn't rethink

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: the factories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It was only after they reinvented them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and we describe how in the book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then you suddenly got a doubling and tripling

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of productivity growth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But it's the combination of the technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: with the new business models, new business organization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That just takes a long time and it takes more creativity

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than most people have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Can you maybe linger on electricity

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: because that's the fun one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, well, I'll tell you what happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Before electricity, there were basically steam engines

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or sometimes water wheels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And to power the machinery, you had

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to have pulleys and crankshafts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And you really can't make them too long

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: because they'll break the torsion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So all the equipment was kind of clustered around this

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: one giant steam engine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You can't make small steam engines either

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: because of thermodynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So if you have one giant steam engine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: all the equipment clustered around it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: multi-story, they have it vertical to minimize the distance

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: as well as horizontal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then when they did electricity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they took out the steam engine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: They got the biggest electric motor they could buy

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: from General Electric or someone like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And nothing much else changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It took until a generation of managers retired

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or died three years later,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that people started thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: wait, we don't have to do it that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You can make electric motors, big, small, medium.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You can put one with each piece of equipment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's this big debate if you read the management literature

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: between what they call group drive versus unit drive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: where every machine would have its own motor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Well, once they did that, once they went to unit drive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: those guys won the debate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then you started having a new kind of factory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: which is sometimes spread out over acres, single story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And each piece of equipment had its own motor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And most importantly, they weren't laid out

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: based on who needed the most power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: They were laid out based on

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: what is the workflow of materials?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Assembly line, let's have it go from this machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to that machine to that machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Once they rethought the factory that way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: huge increases in productivity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It was just staggering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: People like Paul David have documented this

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in their research papers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I think that there's a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that is a lesson you see over and over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It happened when the steam engine changed manual production.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's happened with the computerization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: People like Michael Hammer said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: don't automate, obliterate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In each case, the big gains only came once

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: smart entrepreneurs and managers

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: basically reinvented their industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, one other interesting point about all that

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is that during that reinvention period,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you often actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: not only don't see productivity growth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you can actually see a slipping back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Measured productivity actually falls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I just wrote a paper with Chad Severson and Daniel Rock

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: called the Productivity J-Curve,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: which basically shows that in a lot of these cases,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you have a downward dip before it goes up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that downward dip is when everyone's trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to like reinvent things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And you could say that they're creating knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and intangible assets,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but that doesn't show up on anyone's balance sheet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It doesn't show up in GDP.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So it's as if they're doing nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Like take self-driving cars, we're just talking about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There have been hundreds of billions of dollars

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: spent developing self-driving cars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And basically no chauffeur has lost his job,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: no taxi driver.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I guess I gotta check on the ones that-

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's a big J-Curve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, so there's a bunch of spending

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and no real consumer benefit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Now they're doing that in the belief,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think the justified belief,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that they will get the upward part of the J-Curve

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and there will be some big returns,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but in the short run, you're not seeing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's happening with a lot of other AI technologies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: just as it happened with earlier

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: general purpose technologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it's one of the reasons we're having

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: relatively low productivity growth lately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: As an economist, one of the things that disappoints me

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is that as eye popping as these technologies are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you and I are both excited about some of the things

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The economic productivity statistics are kind of dismal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We actually, believe it or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: have had lower productivity growth in the past

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: about 15 years than we did in the previous 15 years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the 90s and early 2000s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so that's not what you would have expected

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: if these technologies were that much better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But I think we're in kind of a long J-Curve there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Personally, I'm optimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We'll start seeing the upward tick,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: maybe as soon as next year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But the past decade has been a bit disappointing

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: if you thought there's a one-to-one relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: between cool technology and higher productivity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: What would you place your biggest hope

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: for productivity increases on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Because you kind of said at a high level AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but if I were to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: what has been so revolutionary in the last 10 years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I would, 15 years, and thinking about the internet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I would say things like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: hope I'm not saying anything ridiculous,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but everything from Wikipedia to Twitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So like these kind of websites, not so much AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but like I would expect to see some kind of big

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: productivity increases from just the connectivity

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: between people and the access to more information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, well, that's another area

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I've done quite a bit of research on actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is these free goods like Wikipedia, Facebook, Twitter, Zoom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We're actually doing this in person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but almost everything else I do these days is online.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The interesting thing about all those is

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: most of them have a price of zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: What do you pay for Wikipedia?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Maybe like a little bit for the electrons

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to come to your house, basically zero, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Take a small pause and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I donate to Wikipedia often, you should too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Cause that makes- Good for you, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But what does that do mean for GDP?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: GDP is based on the price and quantity

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of all the goods things bought and sold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: If something has zero price,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you know how much it contributes to GDP?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: To a first approximation, zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So these digital goods that we're getting more and more of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we're spending more and more hours a day

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: consuming stuff off of screens, little screens, big screens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That doesn't get priced into GDP, it's like they don't exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That doesn't mean they don't create value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I get a lot of value from watching cat videos

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and reading Wikipedia articles and listening to podcasts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: even if I don't pay for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So we've got a mismatch there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Now in fairness, economists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: since Simon Kuznets invented GDP and productivity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: all those statistics back in the 1930s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: he recognized, he in fact said, this is not a measure

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of wellbeing, this is not a measure of welfare,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it's a measure of production.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But almost everybody has kind of forgotten that he said that

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and they just use it, it's like, how well off are we?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: What was GDP last year?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It was 2.3% growth or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That is how much physical production,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but it's not the value we're getting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We need a new set of statistics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I'm working with some colleagues,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Avi Collis and others to develop something

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we call GDP-B.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: GDP-B measures the benefits you get, not the cost.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: If you get benefit from Zoom or Wikipedia or Facebook,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then that gets counted in GDP-B, even if you pay zero for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So, back to your original point,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think there is a lot of gain over the past decade

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in these digital goods that doesn't show up in GDP,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: doesn't show up in productivity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: By the way, productivity is just defined

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: as GDP divided by hours worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So, if you mismeasure GDP,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you mismeasure productivity by the exact same amount.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's something we need to fix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I'm working with the statistical agencies

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to come up with a new set of metrics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And over the coming years, I think we'll see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we're not gonna do away with GDP, it's very useful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but we'll see a parallel set of accounts

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that measure the benefits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: How difficult is it to get that B in the GDP-B?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's pretty hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, one of the reasons it hasn't been done before

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is that you can measure the cash register,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: what people pay for stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but how do you measure what they would have paid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like what the value is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's a lot harder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: How much is Wikipedia worth to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's what we have to answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And to do that, what we do is we can use online experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We do massive online choice experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We ask hundreds of thousands, now millions of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to do lots of sort of A-B tests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: How much would I have to pay you

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to give up Wikipedia for a month?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: How much would I have to pay you to stop using your phone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And in some cases, it's hypothetical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In other cases, we actually enforce it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: which is kind of expensive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Like we pay somebody $30 to stop using Facebook

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and we see if they'll do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And some people will give it up for $10.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Some people won't give it up even if you give them $100.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then you get a whole demand curve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You get to see what all the different prices are

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and how much value different people get.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And not surprisingly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: different people have different values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We find that women tend to value Facebook more than men.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Old people tend to value it a little bit more

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than young people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That was interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think young people maybe know about other networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that I don't know the name of that are better than Facebook.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so you get to see these patterns,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but every person's individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then if you add up all those numbers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you start getting an estimate of the value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Okay, first of all, that's brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Is this work that will soon eventually be published?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, well, there's a version of it

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: about, I think we call it Massive Online Choice Experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I should remember the title, but it's on my website.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So yeah, we have some more papers coming out on it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but the first one is already out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's kind of a fascinating mystery

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that Twitter, Facebook, all these social networks are free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it seems like almost none of them, except for YouTube,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: have experimented with removing ads for money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Can you like, do you understand that

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: from both economics and the product perspective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, it's something that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: so I teach a course on digital business models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So I used to do it at MIT at Stanford, I'm not quite sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I'm not teaching until next spring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I'm still thinking about what my course is gonna be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But there are a lot of different business models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And when you have something that has zero marginal cost,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: there's a lot of forces,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: especially if there's any kind of competition

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that push prices down to zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But you can have ad supported systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you can bundle things together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You can have volunteer, you mentioned Wikipedia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: there's donations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I think economists underestimate

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: the power of volunteerism and donations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Your National Public Radio, actually, how do you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: this podcast, how is this, what's the revenue model?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's sponsors at the beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then, and people, the funny thing is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I tell people they can, it's very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I tell them to start timestamps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So if you wanna skip the sponsors, you're free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But it's funny that a bunch of people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: so I read the advertisement

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and a bunch of people enjoy reading it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it's-

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Well, they may learn something from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And also, from the advertiser's perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: those are people who are actually interested.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, the example I sometimes gave is like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I bought a car recently and all of a sudden,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: all the car ads were like interesting to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then like, now that I have the car,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like I sort of zone out on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but that's fine, the car companies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they don't really wanna be advertising to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: if I'm not gonna buy their product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So there are a lot of these different revenue models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it's a little complicated,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but the economic theory has to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: with what the shape of the demand curve is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: when it's better to monetize it with charging people

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: versus when you're better off doing advertising.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, in short, when the demand curve

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is relatively flat and wide,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like generic news and things like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then you tend to do better with advertising.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: If it's a good that's only useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to a small number of people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but they're willing to pay a lot,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they have a very high value for it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then you advertising isn't gonna work as well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you're better off charging for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Both of them have some inefficiencies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then when you get into targeting

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and you get these other revenue models,
