metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You know, I've played around with some of those VR headsets

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and they're not great, but I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: the average person spends many waking hours

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: staring at screens right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You know, they're kind of low res compared to

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: what they could be in 30 or 50 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But certainly games and why not any other interactions

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: could be done with VR.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that would be a pretty different world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And we'd all, you know, in some ways be as rich as we wanted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You know, we could have castles

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and we could be traveling anywhere we want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it could obviously be multi-sensory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So that would be, that would be possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And you know, there's people, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you've had Elon Musk on and others, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: there are people, Nick Bostrom, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: makes the simulation argument that maybe we're already there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We're already there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So, but in general, or do you not even think about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in this kind of way, you're self-critically thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: how good are you as an economist at predicting

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: what the future looks like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Do you have a-

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Well, it starts getting, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I feel reasonably comfortable at next, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: five, 10, 20 years in terms of that path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: When you start getting truly superhuman

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: artificial intelligence, kind of by definition,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I'd be able to think of a lot of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that I couldn't have thought of

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and create a world that I couldn't even imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so I'm not sure I can predict what that world

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is going to be like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: One thing that AI researchers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: AI safety researchers worry about

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is what's called the alignment problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: When an AI is that powerful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then they can do all sorts of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And you really hope that their values

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: are aligned with our values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it's even tricky to finding what our values are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, first off, we all have different values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And secondly, maybe if we were smarter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we would have better values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Like, you know, I like to think that we have better values

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than we did in 1860,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or in the year 200 BC on a lot of dimensions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: things that we consider barbaric today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And it may be that if I thought about it more deeply,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I would also be morally evolved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Maybe I'd be a vegetarian or do other things

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that right now, whether my future self

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: would consider kind of immoral.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So that's a tricky problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: getting the AI to do what we want,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: assuming it's even a friendly AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, I should probably mention,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: there's a non-trivial other branch

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: where we destroy ourselves, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, there's a lot of exponentially improving technologies

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that could be ferociously destructive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: whether it's in nanotechnology or biotech

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and weaponized viruses, AI and other things that-

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Nuclear weapons. Nuclear weapons, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The old school technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, good old nuclear weapons

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that could be devastating or even existential

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and new things yet to be invented.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So that's a branch that I think is pretty significant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And there are those who think that one of the reasons

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we haven't been contacted by other civilizations, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Is that once you get to a certain level

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of complexity in technology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: there's just too many ways to go wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's a lot of ways to blow yourself up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And people, or I should say species,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: end up falling into one of those traps, the great filter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The great filter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, there's an optimistic view of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: If there is literally no intelligent life

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: out there in the universe, or at least in our galaxy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that means that we've passed at least one

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of the great filters or some of the great filters

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that we survived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, no, I think it's Robin Hansen has a good way of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: maybe others, they have a good way of thinking about this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that if there are no other intelligence creatures out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and that we've been able to detect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: one possibility is that there's a filter ahead of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And when you get a little more advanced,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: maybe in a hundred or a thousand or 10,000 years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: things just get destroyed for some reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The other one is the great filters behind us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That will be good is that most planets

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: don't even evolve life, or if they don't evolve life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they don't involve intelligent life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Maybe we've gotten past that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so now maybe we're on the good side of the great filter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So if we sort of rewind back and look at the thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: where we could say something a little bit more comfortably

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: at five years and 10 years out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you've written about jobs and the impact

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: on sort of our economy and the jobs

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in terms of artificial intelligence that it might have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's a fascinating question of what kind of jobs are safe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: what kind of jobs are not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Can you maybe speak to your intuition

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: about how we should think about AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: changing the landscape of work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Sure, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Well, this is a really important question

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: because I think we're very far

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: from artificial general intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: which is AI that can just do the full breadth

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of what humans can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But we do have human level or superhuman level,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: narrow intelligence, narrow artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And obviously my calculator can do math

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a lot better than I can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And there's a lot of other things

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that machines can do better than I can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So which is which?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We actually set out to address that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: With Tom Mitchell, I wrote a paper called

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: What Can Machine Learning Do That Was In Science?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And we went and interviewed a whole bunch of AI experts

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and kind of synthesized what they thought

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: machine learning was good at and wasn't good at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And we came up with what we called a rubric,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: basically a set of questions you can ask about any task

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that will tell you whether it's likely to score high or low

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: on suitability for machine learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then we've applied that to a bunch of tasks

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In fact, there's a data set of all the tasks

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the US economy, believe it or not, it's called ONET.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The US government put it together,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: part of Bureau of Labor Statistics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: They divide the economy into about 970 occupations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like bus driver, economist, primary school teacher,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: radiologist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then for each one of them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they describe which tasks need to be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Like for radiologist, there are 27 distinct tasks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So we went through all those tasks to see whether or not

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a machine could do them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And what we found interestingly was-

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Brilliant study by the way, that's so awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So what we found was that there was no occupation

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in our data set where machine learning just ran the table

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and did everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And there was almost no occupation where machine learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: didn't have like a significant ability to do things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Like take radiology, a lot of people I hear saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you know, it's the end of radiology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And one of the 27 tasks is read medical images,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: really important one, like it's kind of a core job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And machines have basically gotten as good or better

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than radiologists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There was just an article in Nature last week,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but they've been publishing them for the past few years

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: showing that machine learning can do as well as humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: on many kinds of diagnostic imaging tasks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But other things radiologists do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they sometimes administer conscious sedation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: They sometimes do physical exams.

body.input: But then I talked to my sociologist friends

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And you know, you can deal with the need thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And when, you know, say steel workers or coal miners

body.input: lost their jobs and were just given checks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So it's not as simple as just writing people a check.

body.input: You need to also give them a way to have a sense of purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that was important to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And the second thing is that, as I mentioned earlier,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and then make money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So there's an incentive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's not a big problem there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And smart companies, Amazon, Tesla,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and others are investing in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The problem is with basic research,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like coming up with core basic ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: whether it's in nuclear fusion

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or artificial intelligence or biotech.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There, if someone invents something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it's very hard for them to capture the benefits from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's shared by everybody, which is great in a way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but it means that they're not gonna have the incentives

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to put as much effort into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There you need, it's a classic public good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There you need the government to be involved in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And the US government used to be investing much more

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in R&D, but we have slashed that part of the government

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: really foolishly and we're all poorer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: significantly poorer as a result.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Growth rates are down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We're not having the kind of scientific progress

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we used to have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's been sort of a short-term, eating the seed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: corn, whatever metaphor you wanna use,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: where people grab some money, put it in their pockets today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but five, 10, 20 years later,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they're a lot poorer than they otherwise would have been.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So we're living through a pandemic right now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: globally in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: From an economics perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: how do you think this pandemic will change the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's been remarkable and it's horrible

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: how many people have suffered,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: the amount of death, the economic destruction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's also striking just the amount of change in work

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that I've seen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In the last 20 weeks, I've seen more change

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than there were in the previous 20 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's been nothing like it

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: since probably the World War II mobilization

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in terms of reorganizing our economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The most obvious one is the shift to remote work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I and many other people stopped going into the office

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and teaching my students in person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I did a study on this with a bunch of colleagues

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: at MIT and elsewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And what we found was that before the pandemic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the beginning of 2020, about one in six,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a little over 15% of Americans were working remotely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: When the pandemic hit, that grew steadily and hit 50%,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: roughly half of Americans working at home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So a complete transformation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And of course, it wasn't even,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it wasn't like everybody did it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: If you're an information worker, professional,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: if you work mainly with data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then you're much more likely to work at home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: If you're a manufacturing worker,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: working with other people or physical things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then it wasn't so easy to work at home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And instead, those people were much more likely

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to become laid off or unemployed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So it's been something that's had very disparate effects

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: on different parts of the workforce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Do you think it's gonna be sticky in a sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that after vaccine comes out and the economy reopens,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: do you think remote work will continue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: That's a great question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: My hypothesis is yes, a lot of it will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Of course, some of it will go back,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but a surprising amount of it will stay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I personally, for instance, I moved my seminars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: my academic seminars to Zoom,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and I was surprised how well it worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Yeah, I mean, obviously we were able to reach

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: a much broader audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So we have people tuning in from Europe

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and other countries,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: just all over the United States for that matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I also actually found that it, in many ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: is more egalitarian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We use the chat feature and other tools,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and grad students and others

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: who might've been a little shy about speaking up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we now kind of have more of ability for lots of voices,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and they're answering each other's questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So you kind of get parallel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Like if someone had some question about some of the data

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or a reference or whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: then someone else in the chat would answer it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And the whole thing just became like a higher bandwidth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: higher quality thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So I thought that was kind of interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think a lot of people are discovering

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that these tools that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: thanks to technologists have been developed

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: over the past decade,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they're a lot more powerful than we thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, all the terrible things we've seen with COVID

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and the real failure of many of our institutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that I thought would work better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: One area that's been a bright spot is our technologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Bandwidth has held up pretty well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and all of our email and other tools

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: have just scaled up kind of gracefully.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So that's been a plus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Economists call this question

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of whether it'll go back a hysteresis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The question is like when you boil an egg,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: after it gets cold again, it stays hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I think that we're gonna have a fair amount

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of hysteresis in the economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We're gonna move to this new,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: we have moved to a new remote work system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and it's not gonna snap all the way back

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to where it was before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: One of the things that worries me is that the people

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: with lots of followers on Twitter and people with voices,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: people that can, voices that can be magnified by reporters

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and all that kind of stuff are the people that fall

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: into this category that we were referring to just now

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: where they can still function

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and be successful with remote work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And then there is a kind of quiet suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of what feels like millions of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: whose jobs are disturbed profoundly by this pandemic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but they don't have many followers on Twitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: What do we, and again, I apologize,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but I've been reading the rise and fall of the Third Reich

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and there's a connection to the depression

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: on the American side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's a deep complicated connection

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to how suffering can turn into forces

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that potentially change the world in destructive ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So like it's something I worry about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's like, what is this suffering going to materialize itself

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in five, 10 years?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Is that something you worry about, think about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's like the center of what I worry about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And let me break it down to two parts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: There's a moral and ethical aspect to it

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that we need to relieve this suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I mean, I'm share the values of, I think, most Americans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We like to see shared prosperity

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or most people on the planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And we would like to see people not falling behind

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and they have fallen behind, not just due to COVID,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but in the previous couple of decades,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: median income has barely moved,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: depending on how you measure it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And the incomes of the top 1% have skyrocketed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And part of that is due to the ways technology has been used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Part of this been due to, frankly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: our political system has continually shifted more wealth

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: into those people who have the powerful interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So there's just, I think, a moral imperative

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to do a better job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And ultimately, we're all gonna be wealthier

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: if more people can contribute,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: more people have the wherewithal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But the second thing is that there's a real political risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I'm not a political scientist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but you don't have to be one, I think, to see how a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: of people are really upset with their getting a raw deal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And they are going to, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: they wanna smash the system in different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: In 2016 and 2018, and now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think there are a lot of people who are looking

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: at the political system and they feel like it's not working

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: for them and they just wanna do something radical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Unfortunately, demagogues have harnessed that in a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that is pretty destructive to the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And an analogy I see is what happened with trade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You know, almost every economist thinks

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that free trade is a good thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that when two people voluntarily exchange,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: almost by definition, they're both better off

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: if it's voluntary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so generally, trade is a good thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but they also recognize that trade can lead

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to uneven effects, that there can be winners and losers

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in some of the people who didn't have the skills

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: to compete with somebody else or didn't have other assets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so trade can shift prices

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in ways that are averse to some people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: So there's a formula that economists have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: which is that you have free trade,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but then you compensate the people who were hurt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And free trade makes the pie bigger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And since the pie is bigger,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: it's possible for everyone to be better off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You can make the winners better off,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but you can also compensate those who don't win.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so they end up being better off as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: What happened was that we didn't fulfill that promise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We did have some more increased free trade

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: in the 80s and 90s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but we didn't compensate the people who were hurt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so they felt like the people in power

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: reneged on the bargain, and I think they did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so then there's a backlash against trade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And now both political parties,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but especially Trump and company,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: have really pushed back against free trade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Ultimately, that's bad for the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Ultimately, that's bad for living standards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But in a way, I can understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that people felt they were betrayed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Technology has a lot of similar characteristics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Technology can make us all better off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It makes the pie bigger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It creates wealth and health, but it can also be uneven.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Not everyone automatically benefits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's possible for some people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: even a majority of people to get left behind

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: while a small group benefits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: What most economists would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: well, let's make the pie bigger,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but let's make sure we adjust the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: so that we compensate the people who are hurt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And since the pie is bigger, we can make the rich richer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We can make the middle-class richer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: We can make the poor richer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Mathematically, everyone could be better off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But again, we're not doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And again, people are saying, this isn't working for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And again, instead of fixing the distribution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: hey, technology sucks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And-

Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: But he made a really good intellectual argument for it too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: Of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It just didn't strike me as right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I think that while I am kind of a utilitarian,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: like I do think we should do the greatest good

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I think I've convinced myself that real happiness

body.input: doesn't come from seeking pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's kind of a little, it's ironic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think it doesn't work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: You gotta like be doing something bigger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think the analogy I sometimes use is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you know, when you look at a dim star in the sky,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but you have to look a little to the side

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and then the parts of your retina

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that are better at absorbing light,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you know, can pick it up better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: It's the same thing with happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: I think you need to sort of find something other goal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: something, some meaning in life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And that ultimately makes you happier

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than if you go squarely at just pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And so for me, you know, the kind of research I do

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that I think is trying to change the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: make the world a better place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And I'm not like an evolutionary psychologist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: but my guess is that our brains are wired,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: not just for pleasure, but we're social animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and we're wired to like help others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And ultimately, you know, that's something

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: that's really deeply rooted in our psyche.

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: And if we do help others, if we do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: or at least feel like we're helping others,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: you know, our reward systems kick in

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: and we end up being more deeply satisfied

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: than if we just do something selfish and shallow.

body.input: Beautifully put,

metadata.title: Podcast: Erik Brynjolfsson: Economics of AI, Social Networks, and Technology | Lex Fridman Podcast #141

body.input: The following is a conversation with Avi Loeb, an astrophysicist, astronomer, and cosmologist at Harvard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: He has authored over 800 papers and written eight books, including his latest, called

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Extraterrestrial, The First Sign of Intelligent Life Beyond Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It will be released in a couple of weeks, so go pre-order it now to show support for what I think is truly an important book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: in that it serves as a strong example of a scientist being both rigorous and open-minded about the question of intelligent alien civilizations in our universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154
