metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So the choice is a fasting app, fasting fuel, fast-breaking, delicious meals, and a history podcast that has very little to do with fasting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Choose wisely, my friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if you wish, click the sponsor links below to get a discount and to support this podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: As a side note, let me say a bit more about why Avi's work is so exciting to me and I think to a lot of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In 2017, a strange interstellar object now named Amuamua, it's fun to say, was detected traveling through our solar system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Based on the evidence we have, it has strange characteristics which made it not like any asteroid or comet that we've seen before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Avi was one of the only world-class scientists who fearlessly suggested that we should be open-minded about whether it is naturally made

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: or in fact is an artifact of an intelligent alien civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In fact, he suggested that the more likely explanation given the evidence is the latter hypothesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We also talk about a lot of fascinating mysteries in our universe, including black holes, dark matter, the Big Bang, and close to speed of light space travel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The theme throughout is that in scientific pursuits, the weird things, the anomalies, the ideas that right now are considered taboo should not be ignored

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: if we're to have a chance at finding the next big breakthrough, the next big paradigm shift, and also if we are to inspire the world with the power and beauty of science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you enjoy this thing, subscribe on YouTube, review on Apple Podcasts, follow on Spotify, support on Patreon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: or connect with me on Twitter at Lex Friedman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And now here's my conversation with Avi Loeb.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In the introduction to your new book, ExoTerrestrial, you write,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: This book confronts one of the universe's most profound questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Are we alone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Over time, this question has been framed in different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Is life here on Earth the only life in the universe?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Are humans the only sentient intelligence in the vastness of space and time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: A better, more precise framing of this question would be this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Throughout the expanse of space and over the lifetime of the universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: are there now or have ever been other sentient civilizations that, like ours, explored the stars and left evidence of their efforts?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So let me ask, are we alone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's an excellent question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: For me, the answer is sort of clear, because I start from the principle of modesty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If we believe that we are alone and special and unique, that shows arrogance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: My daughters, when they were infants, they tended to think that they are special, unique.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then they went out to the street and realized that other kids are very much like them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then they developed a sense of a better perspective about themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I think the only reason that we are still thinking that we are special is because we haven't searched well enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: to find others that might even be better than us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I say that because I look at the newspaper every morning and I see that we do foolish things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We are not necessarily the most intelligent ones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if you think about it, if you open a recipe book, you see that out of the same ingredients,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you can make very different cakes, depending on how you put them together and how you heat them up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And what is the chance that by taking the soup of chemicals that existed on Earth and cooking it one way

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: to get our life, that you got the best cake possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, we are probably not the sharpest cookie in the jar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And my question is, I mean, it's pretty obvious to me that we are probably not alone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: because half of all the sun-like stars we know now as astronomers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: half of the sun-like stars from the Kepler satellite data have a planet the size of the Earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: roughly at the same distance that the Earth is from the Sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that means that they can have liquid water on their surface and the chemistry of life as we know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So if you roll the dice billions of times just within the Milky Way galaxy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and then you have tens of billions of galaxies like it within the observable volume of the universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: it would be extremely arrogant to think that we are special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I would think that we are sort of middle of the road, typical forms of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's why nobody pays attention to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you go down the street on a sidewalk and you see an ant, you don't pay attention or special respect to that ant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You just continue to walk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so I think that we are sort of average, not very interesting, not exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So nobody cares about us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We tend to think that we are special, but that's a sign of immaturity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And we're very early on in our development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes, that's another thing that we have our technology only for 100 years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and it's evolving exponentially right now on a three-year timescale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So imagine what would happen in 100 years, in a thousand years, in a million years or in a billion years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, the Sun is actually relatively late in the star formation history of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Most of the sun-like stars formed earlier, and some of them already died, you know, became white dwarfs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so if you imagine that a civilization like ours existed around a typical sun-like star,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: by now, if they survived, they could be a billion years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then imagine a billion-year technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It would look like magic to us, you know, an approximation to God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We wouldn't be able to understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so in my view, we should be humble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And by the way, we should probably just listen and not speak,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: because there is a risk, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you are inferior, there is a risk if you speak too loudly, something bad may happen to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You mentioned we should be humble also in the sense, with the analogy to ants,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that they might be better than us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there's a kind of scale that we're talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And in the question, you mentioned the word sentient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So sentience, or maybe the more basic formulation of that is consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Do you think that this thing within us humans, in terms of the typical life form of consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: is the essential element that permeates other, if there's other alien civilizations out there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that they have something like consciousness as well?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Or is this...

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I guess I'm asking, can you try to untangle the word sentient?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, so that's a good question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I think what is most abundant, depending on how long it survives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So if you look at us as an example, we are now...

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We do have conscious and we do have technology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: but the technologies that we are developing are also means for our own destruction, as we can tell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We can change the climate if we are not careful enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We can go into nuclear wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So we are developing means for our own destruction through self-inflicted wounds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it might well be that creatures like us are not long-lived,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that the crocodiles on other planets live for billions of years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They don't destroy themselves, they live naturally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so if you look around, the most common thing would be dumb animals that live for long times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: not those that have conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But in terms of changing the environment, I think since humans develop tools,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: they develop the ability to construct technologies that would lift us from this planet that we were born in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and that's something animals without a consciousness cannot really do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so in terms of looking for things that went beyond the circumstances they were born into,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I would think that even if they are short-lived,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: these are the creatures that made the biggest difference to their environment, and we can search for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Even if they are short-lived and most of the civilizations are dead by now, even if that's the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's sad to think about, by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Well, but if you look on Earth, there are lots of cultures that existed throughout time and they are dead by now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The Mayan culture was very sophisticated, died,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: but we can find evidence for it and learn about it just by archaeology, digging into the ground, looking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so we can do the same thing in space, look for dead civilizations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and perhaps we can learn a lesson why they died and behave better so that we will not share the same fate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I think there is a lesson to be learned from the sky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And by the way, I should also say if we find a technology that we have not dreamed of, that we can import to Earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that may be a better strategy for making a fortune than going to Silicon Valley or going to Wall Street,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: because you make a jump start into something of the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So that's one way to do the leap is actually to find, to literally discover versus come up with the idea in our own limited human capacity, like a cognitive capacity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It would feel like cheating in an exam where you look over the shoulder of a student next to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But it's not good on an exam, but it is good when you're coming up with technology that could change the fabric of human civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But there is, in my neck of the woods of artificial intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: there's a lot of trajectories one can imagine of creating very powerful beings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: the technology that's essentially, you can call super intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that could achieve space exploration, all those kinds of things without consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: without something that to us humans looks like consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And there is a sad feeling I have that consciousness too, in terms of us being humble, is a thing we humans take too seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That we think it's special just because we have it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But it could be a thing that's actually holding us back in some kind of way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It may well be. It may well be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I should say something about AI, because I do think it offers a very important step into the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you look at the Old Testament, the Bible, there is this story about Noah's ark that you might know about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Noah knew about a great flood that is about to endanger all life on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So he decided to build an ark.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the Bible actually talks about specifically what the size of this ark was, what the dimensions were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Turns out it was quite similar to Oumuamua that we will discuss in a few minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But at any event, he built this ark and he put animals on it so that they were saved from the great flood.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now you can think about doing the same on earth, because there are risks for future catastrophes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We could have the self-inflicted wounds that we were talking about, like nuclear war, changing the climate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Or there could be an asteroid impacting us, just like the dinosaurs died.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The dinosaurs didn't have science, astronomy. They couldn't have a warning system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But there was this big stone, big rock that approached them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It must have been a beautiful sight. Just when it was approaching, it got very big and then smashed them and killed them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you could have a catastrophe like that. Or in a billion years, the sun will basically boil off all the oceans on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And currently all our eggs are in one basket, but we can spread them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's sort of like the printing press, if you think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The revolution that Gutenberg brought is there were very few copies of the Bible at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And each of them was precious because it was handwritten.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But once the printing press produced multiple copies, if something bad happened to one of the copies, it wasn't a catastrophe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It wasn't a disaster because you had many more copies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so if we have copies of life here on earth, elsewhere, then we avoid the risk of it being eliminated by a single point breakdown, a catastrophe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So the question is, can we build NOx spaceship that will carry life as we know it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, you might think we have to put elephants and whales and birds on a big spaceship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But that's not true because all you need to know is the DNA making, the genetic making of these animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: put it on a computer system that has AI plus a 3D printer so that this CubeSat, which is rather small,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: can go with this information to another planet and use the raw materials there to produce synthetic life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that would be a way of producing copies, just like the Gutenberg printing press.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah. And it doesn't have to be exact copies of the humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It could just contain some basic elements of life and then have enough life on board that it could reproduce the process of evolution on another place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I mean, that also makes you sad, of course, because you confront the mortality of your own little precious consciousness and all your own memories and knowledge and all that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But who cares? I mean, we are not so significant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I care about mine, right? And you care about yours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: No, no, I actually don't. You know, if you look at the big, if you're an astronomer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: one thing that you learn from the universe is to be modest because you're not so significant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Oh, boy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, think about it. All these emperors and kings that conquered a piece of land on Earth and were extremely proud.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, you see these images of kings and emperors that, you know, usually are alpha males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they stand strong and they're very proud of themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But if you think about it, there are 10 to the power 20 planets like the Earth in the observable volume of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And this view of conquering a piece of land that even conquering all of Earth is just like an ant hugging a single grain of sand on the landscape of a huge beach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's not very impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you can't be arrogant if you see the big picture. You have to be humble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, also, we are short lived, you know, within a hundred years. That's it. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So what does it teach you first to be humble, modest?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You never have significant powers relative to the big scheme of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And second, you should appreciate every day that you live and learn about the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Humble and still grateful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Well, let's talk about probably the most interesting object I've heard about and also the most fun to pronounce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Oumuamua.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Oumuamua.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Can you tell me the story of this object and why it may be an important event in human history?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And is it possibly a piece of alien technology?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right. So this is the first object that was spotted close to Earth from outside the solar system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it was found on October 19th, 2017.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And at that time, it was receding away from us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And at first, astronomers thought it must be a piece of rock, you know, just like all the asteroids and comets that we have seen from within the solar system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it just came from another star.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I should say that the actual discovery of this object was surprising to me because a decade earlier, I wrote the first paper together with Ed Turner and Amaya Moro-Martin

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that tried to predict whether the same telescope that was surveying the sky, Pan-Stars, from Hawaii, would find anything from interstellar space, given what we know about the solar system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So if you assume that other planetary systems have similar abundance of rocks and you just calculate how many should be ejected into interstellar space, the conclusion is no, we shouldn't find anything with Pan-Stars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: To me, I apologize, it's probably revealing my stupidity, but it was surprising to me that so few interstellar objects from outside this whole system have ever been detected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: No, nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: None has been, you do, well, maybe talk about it, that there has been one or two rocks since then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Well, since then, there was one called the Borisov. It was discovered by an amateur Russian astronomer, Gennady Borisov, and that one looked like a comet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And just like a comet from within the solar system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But this is a really important point, and sorry to interrupt it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You showed that it's unlikely that a rock from another solar system would arrive to ours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right, and so the actual detection of this one was surprising by itself, to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then, but then, so at first they thought maybe it's a comet or an asteroid, but then it didn't look like anything we've seen before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Borisov did look like a comet, so people asked me afterwards and said, you know, doesn't it convince you that if Borisov looks like a comet, doesn't it convince you that Oumuamua is also natural?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I said, you know, when I went on the first date with my wife, she looked special to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And since then, I met many women that didn't change my opinion of my wife.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They're not nearly as special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, that's not an argument. Anyway, so why did Oumuamua look weird?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Let me explain. So first of all, astronomers monitored the amount of light, sunlight that it reflects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it was tumbling, spinning every eight hours. And as it was spinning, the brightness that we saw from that direction, we couldn't resolve it because it's tiny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's about a hundred meters, a few hundred feet, size of a football field. And we cannot, from Earth, with existing telescopes, we cannot resolve it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The only way to actually get a photograph of it is to send the camera close to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that was not possible at the time that Oumuamua was discovered because it was already moving away from us faster than any rocket we can send.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's sort of like a guest that appeared for dinner. And then by the time we realized that it's weird, the guest is already out the front door into the dark street.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What we would like to find is an object like it approaching us, because then you can send the camera irrespective of how fast it moves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if we were to find it in July 2017, that would have been possible because it was approaching us at that time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Actually, I was visiting Mount Haleakala in Maui, Hawaii, with my family for vacation at that time in July 2017, but nobody knew at the observatory that Oumuamua is very close.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's sad to think about that we had the opportunity at that time to send up a camera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But don't worry. There will be more because I operate by the Copernican principle, which says we don't live at a special place and we don't live at a special time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that means if we surveyed the sky for a few years and we had sensitivity to this region between us and the Sun, and we found this object with panstars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: there should be many more that we will find in the future with surveys that might be even better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And actually, in three years time scale, there would be the so-called LSST.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's a survey of the Vera Rubin Observatory that would be much more sensitive and could potentially find an Oumuamua-like object every month.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I'm just waiting for that. And the main reason for me to alert everyone to the unusual properties of Oumuamua is with the hope that next time around,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: when we see something as unusual, we would take a photograph or we would get as much evidence as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because science is based on evidence, not on prejudice. And we will get back to that theme.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So anyway, let me point out what is-

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Some of the properties actually, the elongated nature, all of those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So the amount of light, sunlight that was reflected from it was changing over eight hours by a factor of 10.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Meaning that the area of this object, even though we can't resolve it, the area on the sky that reflects sunlight was bigger by a factor of 10 in some phases as it was tumbling around than in other phases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So even if you take a piece of paper that is razor thin, there is a very small likelihood that it's exactly edge on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And getting a factor of 10 change in the area that you see on the sky is huge. It's much more than any-

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It means that the object has an unusual geometry. It's at least a factor of a few more than any of the comets or asteroids that we have seen before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You mentioned reflectivity, so it's not just the geometry, but the properties of the surface of that thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Well, if you assume the reflectivity is the same, then it's just geometry. If you assume the reflectivity may change, then it could be a combination of the area that you see and the reflectivity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because different directions may reflect differently. But the point is that it's very extreme.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And actually the best fit to the light curve that we saw was of a flat object. Unlike all the cartoons that you have seen of a cigar shape, a flat object at the 90% confidence gives a better model for the way that the light varied.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So it's like flat meaning like a pancake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Like a pancake, exactly. So that's the very first unusual property. But to me, it was not unusual enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: To think that it might be artificial. It was not significant enough. Then there was no cometary tail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: No dust, no gas around this object. And the Spitzer Space Telescope really searched very deeply for carbon-based molecules. There was nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So it's definitely not a comet the way people expected it to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Can you maybe briefly mention what properties a comet that you're referring to usually has?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right. So a comet is a rock that has some water ice on the surface. So you can think of it as an icy rock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Actually, comets were discovered a long time ago. But the first model that was developed for them was by Fred the Whipple, who was at Harvard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I think the legend goes that he got the idea from walking through Harvard Square during a winter day and seeing these icy rocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So a comet is icy and an asteroid is not. It's just a rock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's just a rock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah. So when you have ice on the surface, when the rock gets close to the sun, the sunlight warms it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the ice sublimates, evaporates. Because the one thing about ice, water ice, is it doesn't become liquid if you warm it up in vacuum, without an external pressure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It just goes straight into gas. And that's what you see as the tail of a comet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The only way to get liquid water is to have an atmosphere like on Earth that has an external pressure. Only then you get liquid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's why it's essential to have an atmosphere to a planet in order to have liquid water and the chemistry of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So if you look at Mars, Mars lost its atmosphere and therefore no liquid water on the surface anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, there may have been early. And that's what the Perseverance Survey, the Perseverance mission, will try to find out whether it had liquid water, whether there was life perhaps on it at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But at some point it lost its atmosphere and then the liquid water was gone. So the only reason that we can live on Earth is because of the atmosphere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But a comet is in vacuum, pretty much. And then when it gets warmed up on the surface, the water becomes, the water ice becomes gas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then you see this cometary tail behind it. In addition to water, there are all kinds of carbon-based molecules or dust that comes off the surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And those are detectable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, it's easy to detect. It's very prominent. You see these cometary tails that look very prominent because they reflect sunlight and you can see them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In fact, it's sometimes difficult to see the nucleus of the comet because it's surrounded and shrouded with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And in this case, there was no trace of anything. Now you might say, okay, it's not a comet. So that's what the community said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay, it's not a comet. No problem. It's still a rock. It's not a comet, but it's just a rock, a bare rock. Okay, no problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Then, and that's the thing that convinced me to write about it. And then in June 2018, significantly later, there was a report that in fact the object exhibited an excess push.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In addition to the force of gravity. So the sun acts on it by gravity, but then there was an extra push on this object that was figured out from the orbit that you can trace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the question was, what is this excess push? So for comets, you get the rocket effect when you evaporate gas, you know, just like a jet engine on an airplane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: A jet engine is very simple. You throw the gas back and it pushes the airplane forward. That's all. That's how a jet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So in a case of a comet, you throw gas in the direction of the sun because it's and then you get a push. Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So in the case of comets, you can get a push, but there was no cometary tail. So then people said, oh, wait a second. Is it an asteroid?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: No, but it behaves like a comet, but it doesn't look like a comet. So what? Well, forget about it. Business as usual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So that's what they mean by a non-garvitation acceleration. So that's interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So like the primary force acting on something like just a rock, like an asteroid would be like you can predict the trajectory based on the gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And also here there's detected movement that's not cannot be accounted purely by the gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if it was a comet, you would need about a tenth of the mass of this comet, the weight of this comet to be evaporated in order to give it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And there was no sign of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: No sign 10% of the mass evaporating. It's huge. Think about it. The hundred meter size object losing 10% of its mass. You can't miss that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so that's super weird. It's super weird.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What is there a good exponent? Is there in your mind a possible explanation for that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, so I operated just like Sherlock Holmes in a way I said, okay, what are the possibilities?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the only thing I could think. So I ruled out everything else and I said it must be the sunlight reflected off it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay. So the sunlight reflects off the surface and gives it a push just like you get a push on a sail on a boat, you know, from the wind reflecting off it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, in order for this to be effective, it turns out the object needs to be extremely thin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It turns out it needs to be less than a millimeter thick. Nature does not produce such things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But we produce it because it's called the technology of a light sail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So we are for space exploration, we are exploring this technology because it has the benefit of not needing to carry the fuel with the spacecraft.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you don't have the fuel, you just have a sail and it's being pushed either by sunlight or by a laser beam or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So perhaps this is a light sail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So this is actually the same technology with the with the Starshot project.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes. So people afterwards say, okay, you work on this project, you imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: No, that's a pretty good explanation, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Obviously, my imagination is limited by what I know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I would not deny that working on light sails expanded my ability to imagine this possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But let me offer another interesting anecdote. In September this year, 2020, there was another object found and it was given the name 2020SO by the Minor Planet Center.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: This is an organization actually in Cambridge, Massachusetts, that gives names to astronomical objects found in the solar system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they gave it that name 2020SO because it looked like an object in the solar system and it moved in an orbit that is similar to the orbit of the Earth, but not the same exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And therefore it was bound to the Sun, but it also exhibited a deviation from what you expect based on gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So they, astronomers that found it, extrapolated back in time and found that in 1966, it intercepted the Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then they realized they went to the history books and they realized, oh, there was a mission called Lunar Lander Surveyor 2 that had a rocket booster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It was a failed mission, but there was a rocket booster that was kicked into space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And presumably this is the rocket booster that we're seeing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now this rocket booster was sufficiently hollow and thin for us to recognize that it's pushed by sunlight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So here is my point. We can tell from the orbit of an object.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Obviously this object didn't have any cometary tail. It was artificially made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We know that it was made by us and it did deviate from an orbit of a rock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So just by seeing something that doesn't have cometary tail and deviates from an orbit shaped by gravity, we can tell that it's artificial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In the case of Oumuamua, it couldn't have been sent by humans because it just passed near us for a few months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We know exactly what we were doing at that time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And also it was moving faster than any object that we can launch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so obviously it came from outside the solar system. And the question is who produced it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now I should say that when I walk on vacation on a beach, I often see natural objects like seashells that are beautiful and I look at them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And every now and then I stumble on a plastic bottle that was artificially produced.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And my point is that maybe Oumuamua was a message in a bottle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And this is simply another window into searching for artifacts from other civilizations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Where do you think it could have come from?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if it's so, okay, from a scientific perspective, the narrow minded view as we'll probably talk about throughout is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you know, you kind of want to stick to the things that naturally originating objects like asteroids and comets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay, that's the space of possible hypotheses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then if we expand beyond that, you start to think, okay, these are artificially constructed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Like you just said, it could be by humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It could be by whatever that means by some kind of extraterrestrial alien civilizations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If it's the alien civilization variety, what is this object then?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's an excellent question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: An excellent question. And let me lay out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, we don't have enough evidence to tell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If we had a photograph, perhaps we would have more information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But there is one other peculiar fact about Oumuamua.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Well, other than it was very shiny that I didn't mention, you know, we didn't detect any heat from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that implies that it's rather small and shiny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But the other peculiar fact is that it came from a very special frame of reference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So it's sort of like finding a car in a parking lot, in a public parking lot that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you can't really tell where it came from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there is this frame of reference where you average over the motions of all the stars in the neighborhood of the sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you find the so-called local standard of rest of the galaxy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's a frame of reference that is obtained by averaging the random motions of all the stars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the sun is moving relative to that frame at some speed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But this object was at rest in that frame.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And only one in 500 stars is so much at rest in that frame.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's why I was saying it's like a parking lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It was parked there and we bumped into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So the relative speed between the solar system and this object is just because we are moving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It was sitting still.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now you ask yourself, why is it so unusual in that context?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know why?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because if it was expelled from another planetary system, most likely it will carry the speed of the host star that it came from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because the most loosely bound objects are in the periphery of the planetary system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they move very slowly relative to the star.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so they carry when they are ripped apart from the planetary system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Most of the objects will have the residual motion of the star, roughly, relative to the local star.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But this one was at rest in the local.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now one thing I can think of, if there is a grid of road posts for navigation system

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: so that you can find your way in the local frame, then that would be one possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: These are like little sensors that are fascinating to think about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there could be, I mean, not necessarily literally a grid, but just evenly in some definition of evenly spread out set of objects like these that are just out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: A lot of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Another possibility is that these are relay stations for communication.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You might think in order to communicate, you need a huge beacon, a very powerful beacon.
