metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay, you will get a prize, but you will be a boring scientist because you will keep repeating things we already know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you want to make progress, if you want to innovate, you have to take risks and you have to look at the evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a dialogue with nature. You don't know the truth in advance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You let nature tell you, educate you, and then you realize that what you thought before is incorrect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And a lot of my colleagues prefer to be in a state where they have a monologue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, if you look at these people that work on string theory, they have a monologue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They know what and in fact, their monologue is centered on anti-deceit or space, which we don't live in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, you know, to me, it's just like the Olympics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, you define a hundred meters and you say whoever runs these hundred meters is the best athlete, the fastest, you know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it's completely arbitrary. You could have decided it would be 50 meters or 20 meters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Who cares? You just measure the ability of people this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you define anti-deceit as a space where you do your mathematical gymnastics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and then you find who can do it the best and you give jobs based on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You give prizes based. But as we said before, you know, nature doesn't care about, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: the prizes that you give to each other. It cares.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, it has its own reality and we should figure it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it's not about us. The scientific activity is about figuring out nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And sometimes we may be wrong. Our image will not be preserved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But it's that's the fun, you know, kids explore the world out of curiosity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I always want to maintain my childhood curiosity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I don't care about the labels that I have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In fact, having tenure is exactly the opportunity to behave like a child because you can make mistakes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I was asked by the Harvard Gazette, you know, the Pravda of Harvard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: what is the one thing that you would like to change about the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes. And I said, I would like my colleagues to behave more like kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah. That's the one thing I would like them to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because something bad happens to these kids when they become tenured professors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They start to worry about their ego and about themselves more than about the purpose of science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: which is, you know, curiosity driven, figuring out from evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Evidence is the key. So when an object shows anomalies like umu umu, what's the problem discussing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, whether it's artificial or not, you know, so there was, I should tell you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: there was a mainstream paper in Nature published saying it must be natural.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's it. It's unusual, but it must be natural, period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then at the same time, some other mainstream scientists tried to explain the properties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they came up with interpretations like it's a dust bunny, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: the kind that you find in a household, a collection of dust particles pushed by sunlight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Something we have never seen before. Or it's a hydrogen iceberg.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It actually evaporates like a comet, but hydrogen is transparent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You don't see it. And that's why we don't see the cometary tape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Again, we have never seen something like that. In both cases, the objects would not survive the long journey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We discussed it in a paper that I wrote afterwards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But my point is those that tried to explain the unusual properties went into great length at discussing things that we have never seen before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay. So even when you think about the natural origin, you have to come up with scenarios that of things that were never seen before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And by the way, they look less plausible to me personally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But my point is if we discuss things that were never seen before, right, why not discuss?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Why not contemplate an artificial origin? What's the problem?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Why do people have this pushback?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, I worked on dark matter and we don't know what most of the matter in the universe is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's called dark matter. It's just an acronym because we have no clue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We simply don't know. So it could be all kinds of particles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And over the years, people suggested weakly interacting massive particles, axions, all kinds of particles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And experiments were made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They cost hundreds of millions of dollars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They put upper limits, constraints that ruled out many of the possibilities that were proposed as natural initially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The mainstream community regarded it as a mainstream activity to search the nature of the dark matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And nobody complained that it's speculative to consider weakly interacting massive particles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, I ask you, why is it speculative to consider extraterrestrial technologies?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We have a proof that it exists here on Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We also know that the conditions of Earth are reproduced in billions of systems throughout the Milky Way galaxy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So what's more conservative than to say if you arrange for similar conditions, you get the same outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: How can you imagine this to be specu- it's not speculative at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And nevertheless, it's regarded the periphery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And at the same time, you have physicists, theoretical physicists, working on extra dimensions, supersymmetry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: superstring theory, the multiverse, maybe we live in a simulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: All of these ideas that have no grounding in reality, some of which sound to me like, you know, just like what someone would say-

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Science fiction, basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because you have no way to test it, you know, through experiments, and experiments really are key.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's not just a nuance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You say, okay, forget about experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: As some philosophers try to say, you know, if there is a consensus, what's the problem?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The point is, it's key.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Then that's what Galileo said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's key to have feedback from reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, you can think that you have a billion dollars or that you are more rich than, you know, Elon Musk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You can feel very happy about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You can talk about it with your friends and all of you will be happy and think about what you can do with the money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Then you go to an ATM machine and you make an experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You check how much money you have in your checking account.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if it turns out that, you know, you don't have much, you can't materialize your dreams.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay, so you realize you have a reality check.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And my point is, without experiments giving you a reality check,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: without the ATM machine showing you whether your ideas are bankrupt or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: without putting skin in the game, and by skin in the game, I mean, don't just talk about theoretical ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Make them testable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you don't make them testable, they're worthless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They're just like theology that is not testable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: By the way, theology has some tests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Let me give you three examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It turns out that my book already inspired a PhD student at Harvard in the English department to pursue a PhD in that direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And she invited me to the PhD exam a couple of months ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And in the exam, one of the examiners, a professor, asked her,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: do you know why Giordano Bruno was burnt at the stake?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And she said, I think it's because he was an obnoxious guy and irritated a lot of people, which is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But the professor said, no, it's because Giordano Bruno said that other stars are just like the sun

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and they could have a planet like the Earth around them that could host life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that was offensive to the church.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Why was it offensive?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because there is the possibility that this life sinned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if that life sinned on planets around other stars, it should have been saved by Christ.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then you need multiple copies of Christ.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's unacceptable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: How can you have duplicates of Christ?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so they burned the guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It was about, okay, I'm just like loading this all in because that's kind of brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So he was actually already into this, not just about the stars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: it's anticipating that there could be other life forms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Like why, if there's other stars, why would our star be special?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: He was making the right argument.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And he would just follow that all along to say like there should be other Earth-like places,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: there should be other life forms, and then there needs to be copies of Christ.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, so that was offensive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I said to that professor, I said, great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I wanted to introduce some scientific tone to the discussion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I said, this is great because now you basically laid the foundation for an experimental test of this theology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What is the test?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We now know that other stars are like the Sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And we know they have planets like the Earth around them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So suppose we find life there and we figure out that they sinned, then we ask them, did you witness Christ?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if they say no, it means that this theology is ruled out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there is an experimental test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So this is experimental test number one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Another experimental test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In the Bible, in the Old Testament, Abraham heard the voice, the voice of God to sacrifice his son, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Only son.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's what the story says.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now suppose Abraham, my name, by the way, had a voice memo up on his cell phone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: He could have pressed this up and recorded the voice of God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that would have been experimental evidence that God exists, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Fortunately, he didn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But it's an experimental test, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There is a third example I should tell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that is Elie Wiesel attributed this story to Martin Buber.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But it's not clear whether it's true or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: At any event, the story goes that Martin Buber, he was a philosopher, and he said the Christians argue that the Messiah arrived already and will come back again in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The Jews argue the Messiah never came and will arrive in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So he said, why argue, both sides agree that the Messiah will arrive in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: When the Messiah arrives, we can ask whether he or she came before, you know, like visited us and then figure it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And one side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So again, experimental test of a theology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So even theology, if it puts a skin in the game, you know, if it makes a prediction, could be tested, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So why can't string theories test themselves or why can't, you know, even cosmic inflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's another model that, you know, one of the inventors from MIT, Alan Guth, argues that it's not falsifiable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: My point is a theory that cannot be falsified is not helpful because it means that you can't make progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You cannot improve your understanding of nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The only way for us to learn about nature is by making hypothesis that are testable, doing the experiments and learning whether we are correct or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So be and coupled that with a curiosity and open mindedness that allows us to explore all kinds of possible hypotheses,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: but always the pursuit of those, the scientific rigor around those hypotheses is ultimately get evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Knowledge is of what nature is should be a dialogue with nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes, rather than a monologue beautifully put.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Can we talk a little bit about the Drake equation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Another framework from which to have this kind of discussion about possible civilizations out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So let me ask within the context of the Drake equation or maybe bigger, how many alien civilizations do you think are out there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Well, it's hard to tell because the Drake equation is again quantifying our ignorance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's just a set of factors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The only one that we know or actually two that we know quite well is the rate of star formation in the Milky Way galaxy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: which we measured by now and the frequency of planets like the Earth around stars and at the right distance to have life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But other than that, there are lots of implicit assumptions about all the other factors that will enable us to detect a signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, I should say the Drake equation has a very limited validity just for signals from civilizations that are transmitting at the time that you're observing them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: However, we can do much better than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We can look for artifacts that they left behind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Even if they are dead, you can look for industrial pollution in the atmosphere of planets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Why do I bring this up?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Again, to show you the conservatism of the mainstream in astronomy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: By the way, I have leadership positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I was chair of the astronomy department for nine years, the longest-serving chair at Harvard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I'm the chair of the board on physics and astronomy of the National Academies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's the primary board.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I'm director of two centers at Harvard and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I do represent the community in various ways, but at the same time, I'm a little bit disappointed by the conservatism that people have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Let me give you an illustration of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The astronomy community actually is going right now through the process of defining its goals for the next decade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There are proposals for telescopes that would cost billions of dollars and whose goal is to find evidence for oxygen in the atmosphere of planets around other stars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: with the idea that this would be a marker, a signature of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, the problem with that is Earth didn't have much oxygen in its atmosphere for the first two billion years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Roughly half of its life didn't have much oxygen, but it had life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It had microbial life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's not clear yet as of yet what the origin is for the rise in the oxygen level after two billion years, about 2.4 billion years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But we know that a planet can have life without oxygen in the atmosphere because Earth did it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The second problem with this approach is that you can have oxygen from natural processes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You can break water molecules and make oxygen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So even if you find it, it will never tell you that for sure life exists there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so even with these billions of dollars, the mainstream community will never be confident whether there is life there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, how can it be confident?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There is actually a way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If instead of looking with the same instruments, if you look for molecules that indicate industrial pollution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: for example, CFCs that are produced by refrigerating systems or industries here on Earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that they do the ozone layer, you can search for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I wrote a paper five years ago suggesting that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, what's the problem?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You can just tell NASA, I want to build this telescope to search for oxygen, but also for industrial pollution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Nobody would say that because it sounds like, you know, on the periphery of the field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I ask you, why would hilarious?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because that's exactly I mean, that would be saying is quite brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, because it's a really strong signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if life if there's alien civilizations out there, then they're probably going to be many of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they're probably going to be more advanced than us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they're probably going to have something like industrial pollution, which would be a much stronger signal than some basic gas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: which could have a lot of different explanations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So like something like oxygen or I mean, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, we could talk about signs of life on Venus and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But like if you want a strong signal, it will be polluted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I love how garbage is nobody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The pollution you have to understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We think of pollution as a problem, but on a planet that was too cold, for example, to have a comfortable life on it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you can imagine terraforming it and putting a blanket of polluting gases such that it will be warmer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that would be a positive change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So if an industrial or a technological civilization wants to terraform a planet that otherwise is too cold for them, they will do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So what's the problem of defining it as a search goal using the same technologies?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The problem is that there is a taboo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We are not supposed to discuss extraterrestrial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There is no funding for this subject, not much, very little.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And young people, because of the bullying on Twitter, all the social media and elsewhere,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: young people with talent that are curious about these questions do not enter this field of study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And obviously, if you step on the grass, it will never grow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right? So if you don't give funding, obviously, the mainstream community says, look, nothing was discovered so far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Obviously, nothing would be discovered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If talented people go to other disciplines, you never search for it well enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You will never find anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, look at gravitational wave astrophysics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a completely new window into the universe pioneered by Ray Weiss at MIT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And at first, it was ridiculed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And thanks to some administrators at the National Science Foundation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: it received funding despite the fact that the mainstream of the astronomy community was very resistant to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And now it's considered a frontier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So all these people that I remember as a young postdoc, these people that bashed this field, said bad things about people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: said nothing will come out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now they say, oh, yeah, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, the Nobel Prize was given to the LIGO collaboration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Of course, now they are supportive of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But my point is, if you suppress innovation early on, there are lots of missed opportunities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The discovery of exoplanets is one example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, in 1952, there was an astronomer called the name Otto Struve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And he wrote a paper saying, why don't we search for Jupiter-like planets close to their host star?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because if they're close enough, they would move the star back and forth and we can detect the signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: OK.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so astronomers on time allocation committees of telescopes for 40 years argued,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: this is not possible because we know why Jupiter resides so far from the Sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You cannot have Jupiter so close because there is this region where ice forms far from the Sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And beyond that region is where Jupiter-like planets can form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There was a theory behind it which ended up being wrong by today's standards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But anyway, they did not give time on telescopes to search for such systems until the first system was discovered four decades after Otto Struve's paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the Nobel Prize was awarded to that just a couple of years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And you ask yourself, OK, so science still made progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What's the problem?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The problem is that this baby came out barely, you know, and there was a delay of four decades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So the progress was delayed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I wonder how many babies were not born because of this resistance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there must be ideas that are as good as this one that were suppressed because they were bullied,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: because people ridiculed them, that were actually good ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And these are missed opportunities, babies that were never born.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I'm willing to push this frontier of the search for technologies or technological signatures for other civilizations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because when I was young, I was in the military in Israel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's obligatory to serve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And there was this saying that one of the soldiers sometimes has to put his body on the barbed wire so that others can go through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I'm willing to suffer the pain so that younger people in the future will be able to speak freely about the possibility that some of the anomalies we find in the sky are due to technological signatures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it's quite obvious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: This is why I like the folks in the artificial intelligence space, Elon Musk and a few others speak about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they look at the long arc.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They say like what, you know, this kind of, you know, you can call it like first principles thinking or you can call anything really is like if we just zoom out from our current bickering and our current like discussions in the what science is doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Look at the long arc of the trajectory we're headed at, which questions are obviously fundamental to science and that should be asked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And which is the space of hypothesis we should be exploring?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And like exoplanets is really good example of one that was like an obvious one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I recently talked to Sarah Seeger and it was very taboo when she was starting out to work on an exoplanet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154
