body.input: Just like you said, that's a wrong way to think about it because we can be detecting some other outputs of the civilizations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But just if we just define broadly how long those civilizations last, do you have a sense of how long they might last?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Like what are the great filters that might destroy civilizations that we should be thinking about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What is in and how can science give us more hints on this topic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I, as I mentioned before, operate by the Copernican principle, meaning that we are not special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We don't live in a special place and not in a special time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And by the way, it's just modesty encapsulated in scientific terms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right? You're saying I'm not special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, I find conditions here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They exist everywhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So if you adopt the Copernican principle, you basically say our civilization transmitted radio signals for a hundred years, roughly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So probably it would last another hundred or a few hundred and that's it because we don't live at a special time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So that's, you know, well, of course, if we get our act together and we somehow start to cooperate rather than fighting each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: killing each other, you know, wasting a lot of resources on things that would destroy our planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Maybe we can lengthen that period if we get smarter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But the most natural assumption is to say that we would live into the future as much as we lived from the time that we start to develop the means for our own destruction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: the technologies we have, which is quite pessimistic, I must say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So several centuries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's what I would give, unless we get our act, unless we become more intelligent than the newspapers report every day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay. Point number one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Second, and by the way, this is relevant, I should say, because there was a report about perhaps a radio signal detected from Proxima Centauri.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What do you make of that signal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Oh, I think it's some Australian guy with a cell phone next to the observatory or something like that because it was the Parkes Telescope in Australia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Okay. I was like, why is it throwing that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So it's human-created noise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, which is always the worry because actually the same observatory, the Parkes Observatory, detected a couple of years ago some signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then they realized that it comes back at lunchtime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they said, okay, what could it be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then they figured out that it must be the microwave oven in the observatory because someone was opening it before it finished.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it was creating this radio signal that they detected with the telescope every lunchtime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So just a cautionary remark.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But the reason I think it's human-made without getting to the technical details is because of this very short window by which we were transmitting radio signals out of the lifetime of the Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, as I said, a hundred years out of four and a half billion years that the Earth existed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So what's the chance that another civilization, a twin civilization of ours, is transmitting radio signals exactly at the time that we are looking with our radio telescopes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: 10 to the minus 7.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, so, and the other argument I have is that they detected it in a very narrow band of frequencies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that makes it cannot be through natural processes, very narrow band.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Just like some radio transmissions that we produce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But if it were to come from the habitable zone, from a transmitter on the surface of Proxima b, this is the planet that orbits Proxima Centauri,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: then I calculated that the frequency would drift through the Doppler effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, just like when you hear a siren on the street, you know, when the car approaches you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: it has a different pitch than when it goes, recedes away from you. That's the Doppler effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And when the planet orbits the star, Proxima Centauri,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you would see or detect a different frequency when the planet approaches us as compared to when it recedes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there should be a frequency drift just because of the motion of the planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I calculated that it must be much bigger than observed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So it cannot just be a transmitter sitting on the planet and sending in our direction a radio signal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: unless they want to cancel the Doppler effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But then they need to know about us because in a different direction, it will not be cancelled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Only in our direction they can cancel it perfectly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there is this direction of Proxima Centauri,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: but I have a problem imagining a transmitter on the surface of a planet in the habitable zone emitting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But my main issue is really with a likelihood, given what we know about ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right. In terms of the durations of the civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The Copernican principle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So nevertheless, this particular signal is likely to be human interference, perhaps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But do you find Proxima be interesting?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Or the more general question is, do you think we humans will venture out outside our solar system

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and potentially colonize other habitable planets?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Actually, I am involved in a project whose goal is to develop the technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that would allow us to leave the solar system and visit the nearest stars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that is called the Starshot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In May 2015, an entrepreneur from Silicon Valley, Yuri Milner, came to my office at Harvard and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: would you be interested in leading a project that would do that in our lifetime?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because as we discussed before, to traverse those distances with existing rockets would take tens of thousands of years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's too long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: For example, to get to Proxima Centauri with the kind of spacecrafts that we already sent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: like New Horizons or Voyager 1, Voyager 2, you needed to send them when the first humans left Africa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So that they would arrive there now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that's a long time to wait.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So Yuri wanted to do it within our lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: 10, 20 years, meaning it has to move at a fraction of the speed of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So can we send a spacecraft that would be moving at the fraction of the speed of light?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I said, let me look into that for six months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And with my students and post-docs, we arrived to the conclusion that the only technology that can do that is the light sail technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Where you basically produce a very powerful laser beam on Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you can collect sunlight with photovoltaic cells or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then convert it into stored energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then produce a very powerful laser beam that is 100 gigawatts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And focus it on a sail in space that is roughly the size of a person, a couple of meters or a few meters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That weighs only a gram or a few grams.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Very thin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And through the math, you can show that you can propel such a sail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you shine on it for a few minutes, it will traverse a distance that is five times the distance to the moon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it will get to a fifth of the speed of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Sounds crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But I've talked to a bunch of people and they're like, I know it sounds crazy, but it's actually, it will work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: This is one of those, it's beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, this is science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the point is people didn't get excited about space since the Apollo era.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it's about time for us to go into space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: A couple of months ago, I was asked to participate in a debate organized by IBM and Bloomberg News.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the discussion centered on the question, is the space race between the US and China good for humanity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Oh, interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And all the other debaters were worried about the military threats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I just couldn't understand what they're talking about because military threats come from hovering above the surface of the Earth, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And we live on a two-dimensional surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We live on the surface of the Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But space is all about the third dimension, getting far from Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So if you go to Mars or you go to a star, another star, there is no military threat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What are we talking about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Space is all about feeling that we are one civilization, in fact, not fighting each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: just going far and having aspirations for something that goes beyond military threats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So why would we be worried that the space race will lead?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's actually brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: In our discourse about it, the space race is sometimes made synonymous with the Cold War or something like that or with wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But really, yeah, there was a lot of ego tied up in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I remember, I mean, it's still to this day, there's a lot of pride that Russians, Soviet Union was the first to space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And there's a lot of pride on the American side that was the first on the moon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But yeah, you're exactly right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There's no aggression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There's no wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And beyond that, if you think about the global economy right now, there is a commercial interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's why Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk are interested about Mars and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There is a commercial interest which is international.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's driven by money, not by pride.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And nations can sign treaties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: First of all, there are lots of treaties that were signed even before the First World War and the Second World War, and the World War took place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So who cares?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, like humans, treaties do not safeguard anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But beyond that, even if nations sign treaties about space exploration,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you might still find commercial entities that will find a way to get their launches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And, you know, so I think we should rethink space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It has nothing to do with national pride.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Once again, nothing to do with our egos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's about exploration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the biggest problem, I think, in human history is that humans tend to think about egos and about their own personal image.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Rather than look at the big picture, you know, we will not be around for long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We are just occupying a small space right now.

body.input: Let's move out of this.

body.input: the PowerPoint presentation about our ambitions for visiting the nearest star.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that was very surreal to me that, you know, look.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Like our origins in many ways, this very primitive origins and our dreams of looking out that is brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So that is incredibly inspiring to me.

body.input: But it's also inspiring of putting humans onto other moons or planets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I still find going to the moon really exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I don't know, maybe I'm just a sucker for it, but it's really exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And Mars, which is a new place, a new planet, another planet that might have life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, there's something magical to that or some traces of previous life.

body.input: And there are risks by going there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But my point is, you know, we started from Africa and we got to apartment buildings in Manhattan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a very different environment from the jungles to live in an apartment building in a small cubicle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And, you know, it took tens of thousands of years, but humans adapted, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So why couldn't humans also make the leap and adapt to a habitat in space?

body.input: Now you can build a platform that would look like an apartment building in the Bronx or somewhere,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: but have inside of it everything that humans need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And just like the space station, but bigger and it will be a platform in space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the advantage of that is if something bad happens on Earth, you have that complex where humans live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And you can also move it back and forth depending on how bright the sun gets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because, you know, within a billion years, the sun would be too hot and it will boil off all the oceans on Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So we cannot stay here for more than a billion years. That's for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes. So that's a billion years from now. I prefer like shorter term deadlines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so in that's I mean, there's a lot of threats that we're facing currently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Do you find it exciting the possibility of, you know, landing on Mars and starting little like building a Manhattan style apartment building on Mars and humans occupying it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Do you think from a scientific or engineering perspective, that's a that's a worthy pursuit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I think it's worthy. But the real issue that is often underplayed is the risk to the human body from cosmic rays.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: These are energetic particles and we are protected from them by the magnetic field around the Earth that blocks them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But if you go to Mars, where there is no such magnetic field to block them, then, you know, a significant fraction of the brain cells in your your head will be damaged within a year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the consequences of that are not clear. I mean, it's quite possible that humans cannot really survive on the surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, it may mean that we need to dig tunnels, go underground or create some protection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: This is something that can be engineered. Yes. And, you know, we can start from the moon and then move to Mars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That would be a natural progression. But it's a big issue that needs to be dealt with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I don't think, you know, it's a showstopper. I think we can overcome it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But, you know, just like anything in science and technology, you have to work on it for a while, figure out solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And but it's not as rosy as Elon Musk talks about. I mean, Elon Musk can obviously be optimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I think eventually it will boil down to figuring out how to cope with this risk, the health risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, I mean, in defense of optimism, I find that there's at least a correlation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If not, their best friends is optimism and open mindedness is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a necessary precondition to do to try crazy things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And in that sense, there the sense I have about going to Mars, if we use today's logic of what kind of benefits we'll get from that, we're never going to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And most decisions we make in life, most decisions we've made as a human species are irrational.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you just if you look at just today, but if you look at the long arc and the possibilities that it might bring, just like humans left Europe and Europe and and and by the way, it was for everybody on the.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But it was a commercial interest that drove that for trade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And, you know, it might happen again in this context. You have people like Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk that are commercially driven to go to space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes, but it doesn't mean that what we ultimately find is not new worlds, you know, that have nothing, you know, much have much more to offer than just commercial interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And as a side effect almost.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, yeah. And then that's why I think, you know, we should be open minded and explore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And however, at the same time, because of the reasons you pointed out, I'm not optimistic that we will survive more than a few centuries into the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that means that we will only survive for the short term.

body.input: I don't know if you have thoughts about this, but what are the things that worry you the most about from the great perspective of the universe, which is the great filters that destroys intelligent civilizations before our own species here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Like, what are the things that worry you the most?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, the thing that worries me the most is that people pay attention to how many likes they have on Twitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And rather than, you know, basketball coaches tell the team players.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Keep your eyes on the ball, not on the audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The problem is we keep our eyes on the audience most of the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Let's keep our eyes on the ball.

body.input: And what does that mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: First of all, in context of science, it means pay attention to the evidence when the evidence looks strange.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Then we should figure it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, I went to a seminar about Oumuamua at Harvard, and a colleague of mine that is mainstream, conservative, would never say anything that would deviate from what everyone else is thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: He said to me after the seminar, I wish this object never existed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, to me, I mean, I just couldn't hear that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What do you mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Nature is whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You have to pay attention to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You cannot say, you know, you cannot bury your head in this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, you should bless nature for giving you clues about things that you haven't expected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I think that's the biggest fault that we are looking for confirmations of things we already know so that we can maintain our pride that we already knew it and maintain our image, not make mistakes because we already knew it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Therefore, we expected the right thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But science is a learning experience, and sometimes you're wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And let's learn from those mistakes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And what's the problem about that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Why is why do we have to get prizes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And why do we get to be honored and maintain our image when the actual objective of science is learning about nature?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And like you've talked about, anomalies in this case are actually not things that are unfortunate and to be ignored are in fact gifts and should be the focus of science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Exactly, because that's the way for us to improve our understanding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: If you look at quantum mechanics, nobody dreamed about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it was revolutionary and we still don't fully understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a pain for us to figure out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So why do you think so?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I understand from the side from the perspective of that's holding our science back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Why do you have a sense that that's also something that might be a problem for us in terms of the survival of human civilization?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because when you look at society, it operates by the same principles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There is people look for affirmation by groups and they, you know, people segregate into herds that think like them, especially these days when social media is so strong, you can find your support group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if you don't look for evidence for what you're saying, you can say crazy things as long as there are enough people supporting what you say, you can even have your newspapers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You can have everything to support your view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then, you know, bad things will happen to society because we're detaching ourselves from reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if we detach ourselves from reality, all the destructive things that naturally can occur in the real world, whether from nuclear weapons, all the kinds of threats that we're facing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: even we're living through a pandemic, the supposed, you know, a much, much worse pandemic can happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then we could sadly, like we did this one politicize in some kind of way and have bickering in the space of Twitter and politics as opposed to there's an actual thing that can destroy the human species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So the only way for us to maintain to stay modest and learn about what really happens is by looking for evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Again, I'm saying it's not about ourself, you know, it's about figuring out what's around us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if you close yourself by surrounding yourself with people that are like-minded, that refuse to look at the evidence, you can do bad things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And throughout human history, that's the origin of all the bad things that happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I think it's a key.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a key to be modest and to look at evidence, and it's not a nuance.

body.input: Now, you might say, oh, OK, the uneducated person might operate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: No, it's the scientific community operates this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: My problem is not with people that don't have an academic pedigree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's included everywhere in society.

body.input: what that idea would do to societies, to the human psyche in general.

body.input: Do you think, and you talk about the, I still have trouble pronouncing, but,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Oumuamua.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Oumuamua wager.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What do you think is, can you explain it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And what do you think in general is the effect that such knowledge might have on human civilization?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right, so Pascal had this wager about God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And by the way, there are interesting connections between theology and the search for extraterrestrial life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's possible that we were planted on this planet by another civilization that we attribute to God powers

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that belong really to the technological civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But putting that aside, Pascal basically said, there are two possibilities, either God exists or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if God exists, the consequences are quite significant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And therefore, we should consider that possibility differently than equal weight to both possibilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I suggest that we do the same with Oumuamua or other technological signatures,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that we keep in mind the consequences and therefore pay more attention to that possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now, some people say extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: My point is that the term extraordinary is really subjective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: For one person, a black hole is extraordinary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: For another, it's just a consequence of Einstein's theory of gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's nothing extraordinary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: The same about the type of dark matter, anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So we should leave the extraordinary part of that sentence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Just keep evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So let's be guided by evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And even if we have extraordinary claims, let's not dismiss them because the evidence is not extraordinary enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because if we have an image of something and it looks really strange and we say, oh, the image is not sufficiently sharp,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: therefore, we should not even pay attention to this image or not even consider, I think that's a mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: What we should do is say, look, there is some evidence for something unusual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Let's try and build instruments that will give us a better image.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And if you just dismiss extraordinary claims because you consider them extraordinary,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you avoid discovering things that you haven't expected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so I believe that along the history of astronomy, there are many missed opportunities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I speak about astronomy, but I'm sure in other fields it's also true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, this is my expertise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: For example, the Astrophysical Journal, which is the main primary publication in astrophysics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: if you go before the 1980s, there are images that were posted in the Astrophysical Journal of giant arcs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you know, arcs of light surrounding clusters of galaxies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And you can find it in printed versions of the Astrophysical Journal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: People just ignore it. They put the image, they see the arc, they say, who knows what it is and just ignore it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then in the 1980s, the subject of gravitational lensing became popular.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the idea is that you can deflect light by the force of gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then you can put a source behind the cluster of galaxies and then you will get these arcs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And actually, Einstein predicted it in 1940.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And, you know, so these things were expected, but people just had them in the images, didn't pay attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I'm sure there are lots of opportunities sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Even in existing data, you have things that are unusual and exceptional and are not being addressed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, you actually, I think you have the article, the data is not enough from quite a few years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Where you talk, you know, we can go back to the 70s and 80s, but we can go also to the Mayan civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right. The Mayan civilization basically believed in astrology that you can forecast the outcome of a war

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: based on the position of the planets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they had, you know, astronomers in their culture had the highest social status.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They were priests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: They were elevated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the reason was that they helped politicians decide when to go to war

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: because they would tell the politicians, you know, the planets would be in this configuration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a better chance for you to win the war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Go to war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And in retrospect, they collected wonderful data, but misinterpreted it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because we now know that the position of Venus or Jupiter or whatever has nothing to do with the outcome of World War I.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, it has nothing to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And so we can have a prejudice and collect data without actually doing the right thing with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: That's such a Pisces thing to say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I looked up what your astrological sign is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you mentioned Einstein predicted that black holes don't exist or just didn't exist in nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Don't exist in nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: When Einstein came up with his theory of gravity in 1915, November 1915, a few months later, another physicist, Karl Schwartzschild,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: he was the director of the Potsdam Observatory, but he was a patriot, a German patriot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So he went into the First World War fighting for Germany.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But while he was at the front, he sent a postcard to Einstein saying, you know, a few months after the theory was developed, saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: actually, I found a solution to your equations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And that was a black hole solution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And then he died a few months later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And Einstein was a pacifist and he survived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So the lesson from this story is that if you want to work out the consequences of a theory, you better be a pacifist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But the point is that this solution was known shortly after Einstein came up with his theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But in 1939, Einstein wrote a paper in the analysis of mathematics saying, even though the solution exists, I don't think it's realized in nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And his argument was, if you imagine a star collapsing, stars often spin and the spin will prevent them from making a black hole, collapsing to a point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So, I mean, can you maybe one of the many things you have worked on, you're an expert in, is black holes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Can you first say what are black holes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And second, how do we know that they exist?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right. So black holes are the ultimate prison.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, you can check in, but you can never check out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Even light cannot escape from them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So there are extreme structures of space and time and there is this so-called Schwarzschild radius or the event horizon of a black hole.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Once you enter into it with a spaceship, you would never be able to tweet back to your friends and tell them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: By the way, I asked the students in my class freshman seminar at Harvard, they said, let me give you two possible journeys that you can take.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I said, suppose aliens come to Earth and suggest that you would board their spaceship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Would you do it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the second is, suppose you could board the spaceship that will take you into a black hole.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Would you do it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So all of them said to the first question, yes, under one condition, that I'll be able to maintain my social media contacts and report back, share the experience with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I couldn't personally, I have no footprint on social media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, which is as a matter of principle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: My wife asked me when we got married and I honor that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I told you offline, I need to get married to such a woman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: She truly is a special lady.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Well, she was wise enough to recognize the risk, but it saves me time and it also keeps me away from crowds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, I don't have the notion of what a lot of other people think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So I can think independently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Crowd think, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But putting, so I was surprised to hear that for students, it's extremely important to share experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Even if they go on a spaceship with aliens, they still want to brag about it rather than look around and see what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: This is not an option when you go to the black hole is exactly the point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So for the black hole, they said no, because obviously you can find your death after you get into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You crash into the singularity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: There is this singularity in the center.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So inside the event horizon, we know that all the matter collects at a point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Now we can't really predict what happens at the singularity because Einstein's theory breaks down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And we know why it breaks down because it doesn't have quantum mechanics that talks about small distances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: We don't have a theory that unifies quantum mechanics and gravity so that it will predict what happens near a singularity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And in fact, you know, I once a couple of years ago, I had a flood in my basement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I mean, I invited the plumber to come over and figure out and we found that the sewer was clogged because of three roots that got into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And we solved the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But then I thought to myself, well, isn't that what happens at the singularity of a black hole?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Because the question is, where does the matter go?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: You know, if you know, in the case of a home, I never thought about it, but the water, all the water that we use goes in through the sewer to some reservoir somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the question is what happens inside a black hole?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And one possibility is that there is an object in the middle, just like a star, you know, and everything collects there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And the object has the maximum density that we can imagine, like Planck densities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's the ultimate density that you can have where gravity is as strong as all the other forces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So you can imagine this object, very dense object at the center that collects all the matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And other possibilities that there is some tunnel just like the sewer, it takes the matter into another place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And we don't know the answer, but I wrote a Scientific American essay about it admitting our ignorance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: It's a fascinating question. What happens to the matter that goes into a black hole?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I actually recommended to some of my colleagues that work on string theory at the closing of a conference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: I'm the founding director of the Black Hole Initiative at Harvard, which brings together astronomers, physicists, philosophers, and mathematicians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And we have a conference once a year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And at the end of one of them, since I'm the director, I had to summarize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I said that I wish we could go on a field trip to a black hole nearby.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And I highly recommend to my colleagues that work on string theory to enter into that black hole,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: because then they can test their theory when they get inside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But one of the string theorists in the audience, Nimar Khani-Hamed, immediately raised his voice and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: you have an ulterior motive for sending us into a black hole, which I didn't deny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But at any event.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Yeah, that's true. That's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Can you say why we know that black holes exist?

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Right. So it's an interesting question because black holes were considered a theoretical construct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And Einstein even denied their existence in 1939.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: But then in the mid-1960s, quasars were discovered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: These are very bright sources of light, a hundred times brighter than their host galaxy, which are point-like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: At the center of galaxies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And it was immediately suggested by Ed Salpeter in the West and by Jakov Zeldovich in the East

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: that these are black holes that accrete gas, collect gas from their host galaxy that are being fed with gas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And they shine very brightly because as the gas falls towards the black holes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: just like water running down the sink, the gas swirls and then rubs against itself and heats up and shines very brightly

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: because it's very hot close to the black hole.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: By viscosity, it heats up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: And in the case of black holes, it's the turbulent viscosity that causes it to heat up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: So we get these very bright sources of light just from black holes that are supposed to be dark.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: Nothing escapes from them, but they create a violent environment where gas moves close to the speed of light

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154

body.input: and therefore shines very brightly, much more than any other source in the sky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154
