body.input: There won't be examples like that. So the errors will be subtle at first. Saddle at first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And in some sense, you can also say that the data that is not out there is a data which would represent how the human learns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And maybe model would be learned, trained on such a data, then it would be better off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: How intelligent is GPT-3, do you think? Like when you think about the nature of intelligence, it seems exceptionally impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But then if you think about the big AGI problem, is this footsteps along the way to AGI?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So let's see. It seems that intelligence itself is there are multiple axis of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I would expect that the the systems that we are building, they might end up being superhuman on some axis and subhuman on some other axis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It would be surprising to me on all axis simultaneously, they would become superhuman. Of course, people ask this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Is GPT a spaceship that that would take us to the moon or are we building a ladder to heaven that we are just building bigger and bigger ladder?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And we don't know in some sense which one of these two works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Which one is better? I'm trying to I like Stairway to Heaven as a good song, so I'm not exactly sure which one is better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But you're saying like the spaceship to the moon is actually effective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Correct. So people who criticize GPT, they say, you guys just building a taller ladder and it will never reach the moon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And at the moment, I would say the way I'm thinking is this is like a scientific question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I'm also in heart, I'm a builder creator and like I'm thinking, let's try out. Let's see how far it goes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And so far we see constantly that there is a progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. So what do you think GPT4, GPT5, GPTn plus one will there be a phase shift, like a transition to a place where we'll be truly surprised?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Then again, like GPT3 is already very like truly surprising.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The people that criticize GPT3 as it's there as a what is it ladder to heaven, I think too quickly get accustomed to how impressive it is that the prediction of the next word can achieve such depth of semantics, accuracy, syntax, grammar and semantics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Do you think GPT4 and 5 and 6 will continue to surprise us?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I mean, definitely there will be more impressive models. There is a question, of course, if there will be a phase shift.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And also even the way I'm thinking about these models is that when we build these models, you know, we see some level of the capabilities, but we don't even fully understand everything that the model can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And actually one of the best things to do is to allow other people to probe the model to even see what is possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Hence the using GPT as an API and opening it up to the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, I mean, so when I'm thinking from perspective of, obviously, various people that have concerns about AGI, including myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then when I'm thinking from perspective, what's the strategy even to deploy these things to the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The one strategy that I have seen many times working is the iterative deployment that you deploy slightly better versions and you allow other people to criticize you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So you actually are tried out. You see where are their fundamental issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And it's almost you don't want to be in that situation that you are holding into powerful system and there's like a huge overhang.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Then you deploy it and it might have a random chaotic impact on the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So you actually want to be in the situation that they are gradually deploying systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I asked this question of Ilya. Let me ask you this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I've been reading a lot about Stalin and power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: If you're in possession of a system that's like AGI, that's exceptionally powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Do you think your character and integrity might become corrupted?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like famously power corrupts and absolute power corrupts. Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So I believe that you want at some point to work toward distributing the power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I think that you want to be in the situation that actually AGI is not controlled by a small number of people, but essentially by a larger collective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So the thing is that requires a George Washington style move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: In the ascent to power, there's always a moment when somebody gets a lot of power and they have to have the integrity and the moral compass to give away that power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That humans have been good and bad throughout history at this particular step.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I wonder, I wonder if we blind ourselves, for example, between nations, a race towards AI race between nations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: We might blind ourselves and justify to ourselves the development of AI without distributing the power because we want to defend ourselves against China, against Russia, that kind of logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I wonder how we design governance mechanisms that prevent us from becoming power hungry and in the process destroying ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So let's see. I have been thinking about this topic quite a bit, but I also want to admit that once again, I actually want to rely way more on Sam Altman on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: He wrote an excellent blog on how even to distribute wealth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And he proposed in his blog to tax equity of the companies rather than profit and to distribute it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And this is an example of a Washington move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I guess I personally have insane trust in Sam.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I mean, he already spent plenty of money running universal basic income project that gives me, I guess, maybe some level of trust to him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But I also, I guess, love him as a friend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, I wonder because we're sort of summoning a new set of technologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I wonder if we'll be cognizant like you're describing the process of open AI, but it could also be at other places like in the US government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Right. Both China and the US are now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Full steam ahead on autonomous weapons systems development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And that's really worrying to me because in the framework of something being a national security danger or a military danger, you can do a lot of pretty dark things that blind our moral compass.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I think AI will be one of those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: In some sense, the mission and the work you're doing at open AI is like the counterbalance to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So you want to have more open AI and less autonomous weapons systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I like this statement. To be clear, this is interesting and I'm thinking about it myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But this is a place that I put my trust actually in Sam's hands because it's extremely hard for me to reason about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. I mean, one important statement to make is it's good to think about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, no question about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: No question about it. Even like low level, quote unquote, engineer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like there's such a. I remember I programmed a car, RC car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: They went really fast, like 30, 40 miles an hour.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I remember I was like sleep deprived, so I programmed it pretty crapily and it like the code froze.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So it's doing some basic computer vision and it's going around on track, but it's going full speed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And there's a bug in the code that the car just went.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It didn't turn. It went straight full speed and smash into the wall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I remember thinking. The seriousness with which you need to approach the design of artificial intelligence systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: and the programming of artificial intelligence systems is high because the consequences are high.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That little car smashing into the wall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: For some reason, I immediately thought of like an algorithm that controls nuclear weapons having the same kind of bug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And so like the lowest level engineer and the CEO of a company all need to have the seriousness in approaching this problem and thinking about the worst case consequences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So I think that is true. I mean, what I also recognize in myself and others even asking this question is that it evokes a lot of fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And fear itself ends up being actually quite debilitating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The place where I arrived at the moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Might sound cheesy or so, but it's almost to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Build things out of love rather than fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I can focus on how I can maximize the value, how the systems that I'm building might be useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I'm not saying that the fear doesn't exist out there and it totally makes sense to minimize it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But I don't want to be working because I'm scared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I want to be working out of passion, out of curiosity, out of the looking forward for the positive future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: With the definition of love arising from rigorous practice of empathy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So not just like your own conception of what is good for the world, but always listening to others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Correct. Like at the love where I'm considering reward functions of others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Others to limit to infinity is like a sum of like one to N where N is seven billion or whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Not projecting my reward functions on others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: OK, can we just take a step back to something else?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Super cool, which is open air codex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Can you give an overview of what open air codex and GitHub copilot is, how it works and why the hell it works so well?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So with GPT-3, we noticed that the system, you know, that system trained on all the language out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Started having some rudimentary coding capabilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So we're able to ask it to implement addition function between two numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And indeed, it can write Python or JavaScript code for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then we thought we might as well just go full steam ahead and try to create a system that is actually good at what we are doing every day ourselves, which is programming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: We optimized models for proficiency in coding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: We actually even created models that both have a comprehension of language and code and codex is API for these models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So it's first pre-trained on language and then I don't know if you can say fine tuned because there's a lot of code, but it's language and code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's language and code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's also optimized for various things like, let's say, low latency and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Codex is the API, similar to GPT-3.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: We expect that there will be proliferation of the potential products that can use coding capabilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I can speak about it in a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Copilot is the first product developed by GitHub.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So as we're building models, we wanted to make sure that these models are useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And we work together with GitHub on building the first product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Copilot is actually as you code, it suggests you code completions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And we have seen in the past there are like various tools that can suggest how to like a few characters of the code or the line of code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The thing about Copilot is it can generate 10 lines of code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's often the way how it works is you often write in the comment what you want to happen because people in comments, they describe what happens next.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So these days when I code, instead of going to Google to search for the appropriate code to solve my problem, I say, oh, for this array, could you smooth it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So when we started robotics, we knew that actually reinforcement learning works and it is possible to solve fairly complicated problems.

body.input: So I asked myself a question, you know, what about robots out there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So we noticed that actually the robots out there, they are kind of at the moment optimized per task.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I asked myself, so what would be a robot that can actually solve many tasks?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It is possible to some extent to prescribe the movements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And with very small amount of intelligence, the movement can be repeated millions of times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: There are also, you know, various pieces of industrial robots where it becomes harder and harder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like, for instance, in case of Tesla, it might be a matter of putting a rock inside of a car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And, you know, because the rock kind of moves around, it's not that easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's not exactly the same every time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That's being the case that you need actually humans to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And while, you know, welding cars together, it's a very repetitive process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Then in case of self-driving itself, the difficulty has to do with the diversity of the environment, but still the car itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The problem that you are solving is you try to avoid even interacting with things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You are not touching anything around because touching itself is hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then if you would have in the home robot that, you know, has to touch things and like if these things, they change the shape, if there is a huge variety of things to be touched,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: then that's difficult. If you are speaking about the robot, which there is, you know, head that is smiling in some way with cameras, that it doesn't, you know, touch things, that's relatively simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: OK, so to both agree and to push back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So you're referring to touch like soft robotics, like the actual touch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But I would argue that you could formulate just basic interaction between like non-contact interaction is also a kind of touch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And that might be very difficult to solve. That's the basic this not disagreement, but that's the basic open question to me with self-driving cars and this agreement with Elon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: which is how much interaction is required to solve self-driving cars, how much touch is required.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You said that in your intuition, touch is not required in my intuition to create a product that's compelling to use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You're going to have to interact with pedestrians, not just avoid pedestrians, but interact with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: When we drive around in major cities, we're constantly threatening everybody's life with our movements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And that's how they respect us. There's a game theory going on with pedestrians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I'm afraid you can't just formulate autonomous driving as a collision avoidance problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So I think it goes beyond like a collision avoidance is the first order approximation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But then at least in case of test, they are gathering data from people driving their cars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I believe that's an example of supervised data that they can train their models on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And they are doing it, which can give a model this like another level of behavior that is needed to actually interact with the real world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, it's interesting how much data is required to achieve that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: What do you think of the whole Tesla autopilot approach, the computer vision based approach with multiple cameras and as a data engine, it's a multitask,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: multi-headed neural network, and it's this fascinating process of similar to what you're talking about with the robotics approach,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: which is you deploy a neural network and then there's humans that use it and then it runs into trouble in a bunch of places and that stuff is sent back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So the deployment discovers a bunch of edge cases and those edge cases are sent back for supervised annotation, thereby improving the neural network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And that's deployed again, it goes over and over until the network becomes really good at the task of driving, becomes safer and safer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: What do you think of that kind of approach to robotics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I believe that's the way to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So in some sense, even when I was speaking about collecting trajectories from humans, that's like a first step.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then you deploy the system and then you have humans revising all the issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And in some sense, like this approach converges to a system that doesn't make mistakes because for the cases where there are mistakes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: you gather data how to fix them and the system will keep on improving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So there's a very, to me, difficult question of how hard that, you know, how long that converging takes, how hard it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The other aspect of autonomous vehicles probably applies to certain robotics applications is society, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: They put as the quality of the system converges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So one, there's a human factors perspective, a psychology of humans being able to supervise those, even with teleoperation, those robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And the other society willing to accept robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Currently, society is much harsher on self-driving cars than it is on human driven cars in terms of the expectation of safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So the bar is set much higher than for humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And so if there's a death in an autonomous vehicle, that's seen as much more dramatic than a death in a human driven vehicle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Part of the success of deployment of robots is figuring out how to make robots part of society, both on the just the human side,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: on the media journalist side and also on the policy government side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And that seems to be maybe you can put that into the objective function to optimize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But that is that is definitely a tricky one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I wonder if that is actually the trickiest part for self-driving cars or any system that's safety critical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's not the algorithm. It's the society accepting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, I would say I believe that the part of the process of deployment is actually showing people that the given things can be trusted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. And trust is also like a glass that is actually really easy to crack it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. And damage it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I think that's actually very common with innovation, that there is some resistance toward it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. And it's just a natural progression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So sometimes people have to keep on proving that indeed the systems are worth being used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I would say I also found out that often the best way to convince people is by letting them experience it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, absolutely. That's the case with Tesla Autopilot, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That's the case with basically robots in general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's kind of funny to hear people talk about robots like there's a lot of fear, even with like legged robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But when they actually interact with them, there's joy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I love interacting with them. And the same with the car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: With a robot, if it starts being useful, I think people immediately understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And if the product is designed well, they fall in love. You're right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's actually even similar when I'm thinking about Copilot, the GitHub Copilot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: There was a spectrum of responses that people had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And ultimately, the important piece was to let people try it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then many people just loved it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Especially like programmers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, programmers. But like some of them, you know, they came with a fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But then you try it out and you think, actually, that's cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And you know, you can try to resist the same way as you could resist moving from punch cards to, let's say, C++ or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And it's a little bit futile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So we talked about generation of program, generation of language, even self-supervised learning in the visual space for robotics and then reinforcement learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: What do you and like this whole beautiful spectrum of AI, do you think is a good benchmark, a good test to strive for to achieve intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That's a strong test of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You know, it started with Alan Turing and the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Maybe you think natural language conversation is a good test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So, you know, it would be nice if, for instance, machine would be able to solve Riemann hypothesis in math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That would be, I think that would be very impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So theorem proving, is that to you proving theorems is a good, oh, like one thing that the machine did, you would say, damn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: OK.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That would be quite impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I mean, the tricky part about the benchmarks is, you know, as we are getting closer with them, we have to invent new benchmarks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: There is actually no ultimate benchmark out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yes. My thought with the Riemann hypothesis would be the moment the machine proves it would say, OK, well, then the problem was easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That's what happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I mean, in some sense, that's actually what happens over the years in AI that like we get used to things very quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You know something I talked to Rodney Brooks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I don't know if you know that is he called Alpha Zero homework problem because you're saying like there's nothing special about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's not a big leap. And I didn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Well, he's coming from one of the aspects that we refer to as he was part of the founding of iRobot, which deployed now tens of millions of robot in the home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So if you see robots that are actually in the homes of people as the legitimate instantiation of artificial intelligence, then yes, maybe an AI that plays a silly game like going chess is not a real accomplishment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: To me, it's a fundamental leap. But I think we as humans then say, OK, well, then that that game of chess or go wasn't that difficult compared to the thing that's currently unsolved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So my intuition is that from perspective of the evolution of these AI systems, we'll at first see the tremendous progress in digital space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And the main thing about this space is also that you can everything is that there is a lot of recorded data, plus you can very rapidly deploy things to billions of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Well, in case of physical space, the deployment part takes multiple years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You have to manufacture things and delivering it to actual people is very hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So I'm expecting that the first and that prices in digital space of goods, they would go down to the let's say marginal costs are zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And also the question is how much of our life will be in digital?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Because it seems like we're heading towards more and more of our lives being in the digital space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So like innovation in the physical space might become less and less significant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like why do you need to drive anywhere if most of your life is spent in virtual reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I still would like, you know, to at least at the moment, my impression is that I would like to have a physical contact with other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And that's very important to me. We don't have a way to replicate it in the computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It might be the case that over the time it will change like in 10 years from now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Why not have like an arbitrary infinite number of people you can interact with?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Some of them are real, some are not with arbitrary characteristics that you can define based on your own preferences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I think that's maybe where we are heading and maybe I'm resisting the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, I'm telling you, I if I got to choose if I could live in Elder Scrolls Skyrim versus the real world, I'm not so sure I would stay with the real world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, I mean, the question is, so will VR be sufficient to get us there or do you need to, you know, plug electrodes in the brain?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And it would be nice if these electrodes wouldn't be invasive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah, or at least like provably non-destructive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But in the digital space, do you think we'll be able to solve the Turing test, the spirit of the Turing test,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: which is do you think we'll be able to achieve compelling natural language conversation between people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: like have friends that are AI systems on the Internet?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I totally think it's doable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Do you think the current approach of GPT will take us there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yes, so there is, you know, the part of at first learning all the content out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I think that still system should keep on learning as it speaks with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I think that should work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The question is how exactly to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And, you know, obviously we have people at OpenAI asking these questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: and kind of at first pre-training on all existing content is like a backbone and is a decent backbone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Do you think AI needs a body connecting to our robotics question to truly connect with humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Or can most of the connection be in the digital space?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So let's see. We know that there are people who met each other online and they fell in love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So it seems that it's conceivable to establish connection, which is purely through Internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Of course, it might be more compelling the more modalities you add.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So it would be like you're proposing like a Tinder, but for AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You like swipe right and left and half the systems are AI and the other is humans and you don't know which is which.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That would be our formulation of Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The moment AI is able to achieve more swipe right or left, whatever, the moment it's able to be more attractive than other humans, it passes the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Then you pass the Turing test in attractiveness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That's right. Well, no, like attractiveness just to clarify.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: There will be conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Not just visual. Right. Right. It's also attractiveness with wit and humor and whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Whatever makes conversations pleasant for humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: OK. All right. So you're saying it's possible to achieve in the digital space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: In some sense, I would almost ask the question, why wouldn't that be possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Right. Well, I have this argument with my dad all the time. He thinks that touch and smell are really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So they can be very important. And I'm saying the initial systems, they won't have it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Still, I wouldn't like their people being born without the senses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And, you know, I believe that they can still fall in love and have meaningful life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. I wonder if it's possible to go close to all the way by just training on transcripts of conversations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like, I wonder how far that takes us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So I think that actually still you want images like I would like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So I don't have kids, but like I could imagine having a tutor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It has to see, you know, kids drawing some pictures on a paper and facial expressions, all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: We use dogs and humans use their eyes to communicate with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I think that's a really powerful mechanism of communication.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Body language, too, that words are much lower bandwidth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And for body language, we still, you know, we kind of have a system that displays an image of its facial expression on the computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It doesn't have to move, you know, mechanical pieces or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So I think that there is like kind of a progression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You can imagine that text might be the simplest to tackle, but this is not the complete human experience at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You expand it to, let's say, images both for input and output.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And what you describe is actually the final, I guess, frontier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: What makes us human? The fact that we can touch each other or smell or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And it's the hardest from perspective of data and deployment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I believe that these things might happen gradually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Are you excited by that possibility, this particular application of human to AI friendship and interaction?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So let's see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like, would you do you look forward to a world you said you're living with a few folks and you're very close friends with them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Do you look forward to a day where one or two of those friends are AI systems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So if the system would be truly wishing me well, rather than being in the situation that it optimizes for my time to interact with the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: The line between those is it's a gray, it's a gray area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I think that's the distinction between love and possession.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And these things, they might be often correlated for humans, but it's like you might find that there are some friends with whom you haven't spoken for months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then, you know, you pick up the phone as the time hasn't passed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: They are not holding to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I wouldn't like to have AI system that, you know, it's trying to convince me to spend time with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I would like the system to optimize for what I care about and help me in achieving my own goals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But there's some, I mean, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: There's some manipulation, there's some possessiveness, there's some insecurities, there's fragility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: All those things are necessary to form a close friendship over time, to go through some dark shit together, some bliss and happiness together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I feel like there's a lot of greedy, self-centered behavior within that process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: My intuition, but I might be wrong, is that human-computer interaction doesn't have to go through a computer being greedy, possessive, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It is possible to train systems, maybe, that they actually, you know, they are, I guess, prompted or fine-tuned or so to truly optimize for what you care about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And you could imagine that, you know, the way how the process would look like is at some point, we as humans, we look at the transcript of the conversation or like an entire interaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And we say, actually, here there was more loving way to go about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And we supervise system toward being more loving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Or maybe we train the system such that it has a reward function toward being more loving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. Or maybe the possibility of the system being an asshole and manipulative and possessive every once in a while is a feature, not a bug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Because some of the happiness that we experience when two souls meet each other, when two humans meet each other, is a kind of break from the assholes in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And so you need assholes in AI as well, because like it'll be like a breath of fresh air to discover an AI that the three previous AIs you had are too friendly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Or cruel or whatever. It's like some kind of mix. And then this one is just right. But you need to experience the full spectrum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like I think you need to be able to engineer assholes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So let's see. Because there's some level to us being appreciated, to appreciate the human experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: We need the dark and the light. So that kind of reminds me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I met a while ago at the meditation retreat, one woman and a beautiful, beautiful woman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And she had a crutch. She had trouble walking on one leg. I asked her what has happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And she said that five years ago she was in Maui, Hawaii.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And she was eating a salad and some snail fell into the salad. And apparently there are neurotoxic snails over there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And she got into coma for a year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And apparently there is a high chance of event just dying. But she was in the coma.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: At some point she regained partially consciousness. She was able to hear people in the room.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: People behaved as she wouldn't be there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: At some point she started being able to speak, but she was mumbling. Like barely able to express herself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: At some point she got into wheelchair. Then at some point she actually noticed that she can move her toe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then she knew that she will be able to walk. And then that's where she was five years after.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And she said that since then she appreciates the fact that she can move her toe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And I was thinking, do I need to go through such experience to appreciate that I can move my toe?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That's a really good story and a really deep example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And in some sense it might be the case that we don't see light if we haven't went through the darkness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But I wouldn't say that we should.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: We shouldn't assume that that's the case. We may be able to engineer shortcuts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Ilya had this belief that maybe one has to go for a week or six months to some challenging camp to just experience a lot of difficulties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then comes back and actually everything is bright. Everything is beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I'm with Ilya on this. It must be a Russian thing. Where are you from originally?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I'm Polish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Polish. Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I'm tempted to say that explains a lot. But yeah, there's something about the Russian, the necessity of suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I believe suffering or rather struggle is necessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I believe that struggle is necessary. I mean, in some sense, you even look at the story of any superhero in the movie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It's not that it was like everything goes easy, easy, easy, easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I like how that's your ground truth is the story of superheroes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Okay. You mentioned that you used to do research at night and go to bed at like 6 a.m. or 7 a.m.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I still do that often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: What sleep schedules have you tried to make for a productive and happy life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like, is there is there some interesting wild sleeping patterns that you engaged that you found that works really well for you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: I tried at some point decreasing number of hours of sleep like a gradually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Like half an hour every few days to this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You know, I was hoping to just save time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: That clearly didn't work for me. Like at some point there's like a phase shift and I felt tired all the time.
