metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: OK. You've been part of development of some of the greatest ideas in artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: What would you say is your process for developing good novel ideas?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: You have to be aware that clearly there are many other brilliant people around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So you have to ask yourself a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Why the given idea, let's say, wasn't tried by someone else?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And in some sense, it has to do with, you know, kind of simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: It might sound simple, but like thinking outside of the box.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And what do I mean here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So, for instance, for a while, people in academia, they assumed that you have a fixed data set and then you optimize the algorithms in order to get the best performance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And that was so in great assumption that no one thought about training models on anti-internet or like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Maybe some people thought about it, but it felt too many as unfair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And in some sense, that's almost like it's not my idea or so, but that's an example of breaking a typical assumption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So you want to be in the paradigm that you are breaking a typical assumption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: In the context of the AI community, getting to pick your data set is cheating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Correct. And in some sense, so that was a that was assumption that many people had out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And then if you free yourself from assumptions, then they are likely to achieve something that others cannot do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: And in some sense, if you are trying to do exactly the same things as others, it's very likely that you're going to have the same results.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Yeah. But there's also that kind of tension, which is asking yourself the question, why haven't others done this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: Because, I mean, I get a lot of good ideas, but I think probably most of them suck when they meet reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So actually, I think the other big piece is getting into a habit of generating ideas, training your brain to generating ideas and not even suspending judgment of the ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: So in some sense, I noticed myself that even if I'm in the process of generating ideas, if I tell myself, oh, that was a bad idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: then that actually interrupts the process and I cannot generate more ideas because I'm actually focused on the negative part, why it won't work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #215

body.input: But I created also an environment in the way that it's very easy for me to store new ideas.

body.input: So again, I come from Russia.

body.input: There's something called the Cold War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: looking at conflict.

body.input: Stephen Pinker written a great book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: do you see a major international conflict

body.input: potentially arising between major nations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: whatever they are, whether it's Russia, China,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: European nations, United States, or others,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: in the next 10, 20, 50 years around AI,

body.input: around the digital space, cyberspace?

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: Do you worry about that?

body.input: Is that something we need to think about

body.input: I believe in greater engagement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: A lot of the worries about more powerful AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: are based on a arms race metaphor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: And when you extrapolate into military kinds of scenarios,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: AI can automate and autonomous weapons

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: that needs to be controlled somehow

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: and autonomous decision-making can lead to not enough time

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: to fix international crises.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: So I actually believe a Cold War mentality

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: then something could easily go wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: I think engagement, interaction, some protocols

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: to avoid inadvertent disasters

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: is actually needed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: So it's natural for each country to want to be the best,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: whether it's in nuclear technologies or AI or bio,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: but I think it's important to realize

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: than if they interacted.

body.input: I think there can still be competition,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

metadata.title: Podcast: Kai-Fu Lee: AI Superpowers - China and Silicon Valley | Lex Fridman Podcast #27

body.input: And I think that engagement is needed.

body.input: So of course we're still far from AI presenting

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: As a side note, let me say a few words about COVID-19

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and about science broadly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think science is beautiful and powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is the striving of the human mind to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and to solve the problems of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But as an institution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it is susceptible to the flaws of human nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to fear, to greed, power, and ego.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: 2020 is the story of all of these

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that has both scientific triumph and tragedy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We needed great leaders and we didn't get them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What we needed is leaders who communicate

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in an honest, transparent, and authentic way

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about the uncertainty of what we know

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and the large-scale scientific efforts

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to reduce that uncertainty and to develop solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I believe there are several candidates for solutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that could have all saved hundreds of billions of dollars

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and lessened or eliminated the suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of millions of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Let me mention five of the categories of solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Masks, at-home testing, anonymized contact tracing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: antiviral drugs, and vaccines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Within each of these categories,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: institutional leaders should have constantly asked

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and answered publicly, honestly, the following three questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: One, what data do we have on the solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and what studies are we running to get more and better data?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Two, given the current data and uncertainty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: how effective and how safe is the solution?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Three, what is the timeline and cost involved

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: with mass manufacturing distribution of the solution?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In the service of these questions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: no voices should have been silenced.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: No ideas left off the table.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Open data, open science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: open, honest scientific communication and debate

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: was the way, not censorship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There are a lot of ideas out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that are bad, wrong, dangerous,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but the moment we have the hubris

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to say we know which ideas those are

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is the moment we'll lose our ability to find the truth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to find solutions, the very things

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that make science beautiful and powerful

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in the face of all the dangers that threaten the wellbeing

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and the existence of humans on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: This conversation with Brett

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is less about the ideas we talk about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We agree on some, disagree on others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is much more about the very freedom to talk,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to think, to share ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: This freedom is our only hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Brett should never have been censored.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I asked Brett to do this podcast to show solidarity

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and to show that I have hope for science and for humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman podcast

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and here's my conversation with Brett Weinstein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What to you is beautiful about the study of biology?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The science, the engineering, the philosophy of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's a very interesting question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I must say at one level, it's not a conscious thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I can say a lot about why as an adult

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I find biology compelling, but as a kid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I was completely fascinated with animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I loved to watch them and think about why they did,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what they did, and that developed

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: into a very conscious passion as an adult,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but I think in the same way that one is drawn to a person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I was drawn to the never-ending series

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of near miracles that exists across biological nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: When you see a living organism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: do you see it from an evolutionary biology perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of this entire thing that moves around in this world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or do you see from an engineering perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that first principles almost down to the physics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: like the little components that build up hierarchies

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that you have cells, first proteins and cells

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and organs and all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So do you see low level or do you see high level?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, the human mind is a strange thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and I think it's probably a bit like a time-sharing machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in which I have different modules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We don't know enough about biology for them to connect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: so they exist in isolation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and I'm always aware that they do connect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but I basically have to step into a module

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in order to see the evolutionary dynamics of the creature

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and the lineage that it belongs to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I have to step into a different module

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to think of that lineage over a very long time scale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a different module still to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what the mechanisms inside would have to look like

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to account for what we can see from the outside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I think that probably sounds really complicated,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but one of the things about being involved in a topic

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: like biology and doing so for one,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: really not even just my adult life or my whole life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is that it becomes second nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And when we see somebody do an amazing parkour routine

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or something like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: we think about what they must be doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in order to accomplish that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But of course, what they are doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is tapping into some kind of zone, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They are in a zone in which they are in such command

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of their center of gravity, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that they know how to hurl it around a landscape

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: so that they always land on their feet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I would just say, for anyone who hasn't found a topic

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: on which they can develop that kind of facility,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it is absolutely worthwhile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's really something that human beings are capable

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of doing across a wide range of topics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: many things our ancestors didn't even have access to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that flexibility of humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that ability to repurpose our machinery for topics

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that are novel means really the world is your oyster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You can figure out what your passion is

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and then figure out all of the angles

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that one would have to pursue to really deeply understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it is well worth having at least one topic like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You mean embracing the full adaptability

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of both the body and the mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So like, I don't know what to attribute the parkour to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: like biomechanics of how our bodies can move,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or is it the mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Like how much percent-wise is it the entirety

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of the hierarchies of biology that we've been talking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or is it just all the mind?

body.input: The way to think about creatures is that every creature

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is two things simultaneously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's not a machine in the, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I call it an aqueous machine, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it's run by an aqueous computer, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So it's not identical to our technological machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But every creature is both a machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that does things in the world sufficient

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to accumulate enough resources to continue surviving,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to reproduce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is also a potential.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So each creature is potentially, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the most recent common ancestor of some future clade

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of creatures that will look very different from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And if a creature is very, very good at being a creature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but not very good in terms of the potential

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it has going forward,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: then that lineage will not last very long into the future

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because change will throw at challenges

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that its descendants will not be able to meet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So the thing about humans is we are a generalist platform

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and we have the ability to swap out our software

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to exist in many, many different niches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I was once watching an interview

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: with this British group of parkour experts

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: who were being, you know, just,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: they were discussing what it is they do

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and how it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And what they essentially said is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: look, you're tapping into deep monkey stuff, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I thought, yeah, that's about right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And, you know, anybody who is proficient at something

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: like skiing or skateboarding, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: for example, bouncing from the top of one mogul to the next.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And if you really pay attention,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I would just say that the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what accounts for this flexibility in humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is the ability to bootstrap a new software program

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and then drive it into the unconscious layer

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: where it can be applied very rapidly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what would evidence for natural origins look like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So one piece of evidence for natural origins

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is that it's happened in the past,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that viruses have jumped.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Oh, they do jump.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So like that's one, like that's possible to have happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So that's a sort of like a historical evidence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: like, okay, well, it's possible that it happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's not evidence of the kind you think it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's a justification for a presumption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Right. Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So the presumption upon discovering

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a new virus circulating is certainly

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that it came from nature, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The problem is the presumption evaporates

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in the face of evidence, or at least it logically should.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it didn't in this case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It was maintained by people who privately

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in their emails acknowledged that they had grave doubts

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about the natural origin of this virus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Is there some other piece of evidence

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that we could look for and see that would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: this increases the probability that it's natural origins?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In fact, there is evidence, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I always worry that somebody is going to make up

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: some evidence in order to reverse the flow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Oh boy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, let's say I am-

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There's a lot of incentive for that actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There's a huge amount of incentive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: On the other hand, why didn't the powers that be,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the powers that lied to us

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about weapons of mass destruction in Iraq,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: why didn't they ever fake weapons

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of mass destruction in Iraq?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Whatever force it is, I hope that force is here too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so whatever evidence we find is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's the competence thing I'm talking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but okay, go ahead, sorry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, we can get back to that, but I would say, yeah,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the giant piece of evidence that will shift

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the probabilities in the other direction

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is the discovery of either a human population

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in which the virus circulated prior to showing up in Wuhan

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that would explain where the virus learned all of the tricks

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that it knew instantly upon spreading from Wuhan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So that would do it, or an animal population

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in which an ancestor epidemic can be found

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in which the virus learned this before jumping to humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I point out in that second case,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: you would certainly expect to see a great deal of evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in the early epidemic, which we don't see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So there almost has to be a human population

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: somewhere else that had the virus circulating

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or an ancestor of the virus that we first saw

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in Wuhan circulating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it has to have gotten very sophisticated

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in that prior epidemic before hitting Wuhan

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in order to explain the total lack of evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and extremely effective virus that emerged

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: at the end of 2019.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So you don't believe in the magic of evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to spring up with all the tricks already there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Like everybody who doesn't have the tricks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: they die quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And then you just have this beautiful virus

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that comes in with the spike protein

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and through mutation and selection,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: just like the ones that succeed and succeed big

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: are the ones that are going to just spring

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: into life with the tricks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, no, that's called a hopeful monster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And hopeful monsters don't work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The job of becoming a new pandemic virus is too difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It involves two very difficult steps

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and they both have to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: One is the ability to infect a person

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and spread in their tissues sufficient to make an infection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the other is to jump between individuals

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: at a sufficient rate that it doesn't go extinct

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: for one reason or another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Those are both very difficult jobs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They require, as you describe, selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the point is selection would leave a mark.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We would see evidence that it was taken place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In animals or humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We would see. Both, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And we see this evolution in trace of the virus

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: gathering the tricks up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, you would see the virus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: you would see the clumsy virus get better and better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And yes, I am a full believer in the power of that process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In fact, I believe it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What I know from studying the process

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is that it is much more powerful than most people imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That what we teach in the Evolution 101 textbook

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is too clumsy a process to do what we see it doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that actually people should increase their expectation

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of the rapidity with which that process can produce

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: just jaw-dropping adaptations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That said, we just don't see evidence that it happened here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which doesn't mean it doesn't exist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but it means in spite of immense pressure

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to find it somewhere, there's been no hint,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which probably means it took place inside of a laboratory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So inside the laboratory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: gain-of-function research on viruses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I believe most of that kind of research

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is doing this exact thing that you're referring to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which is accelerated evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And just watching evolution do its thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and a bunch of viruses

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and seeing what kind of tricks get developed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The other method is engineering viruses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So manually adding on the tricks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Which do you think we should be thinking about here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So mind you, I learned what I know

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in the aftermath of this pandemic emerging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I started studying the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I would say based on the content of the genome

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and other evidence in publications from the various labs

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that were involved in generating this technology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a couple of things seem likely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: SARS-CoV-2 does not appear to be entirely the result

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of either a splicing process or serial passaging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It appears to have both things in its past,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or it's at least highly likely that it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So for example, the fur and cleavage site

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: looks very much like it was added in to the virus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it was known that that would increase its infectivity

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in humans and increase its tropism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The virus appears to be excellent

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: at spreading in humans and minks and ferrets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now minks and ferrets are very closely related to each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and ferrets are very likely to have been used

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in a serial passage experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The reason being that they have an ACE2 receptor

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that looks very much like the human ACE2 receptor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so were you going to passage the virus

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or its ancestor through an animal

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in order to increase its infectivity in humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which would have been necessary,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: ferrets would have been very likely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is also quite likely that humanized mice were utilized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it is possible that human airway tissue was utilized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think it is vital that we find out

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what the protocols were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If this came from the Wuhan Institute,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: we need to know it and we need to know

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what the protocols were exactly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because they will actually give us some tools

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that would be useful in fighting SARS-CoV-2

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and hopefully driving it to extinction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which ought to be our priority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is a priority that does not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it is not apparent from our behavior,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but it really is, it should be our objective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If we understood where our interests lie,
